chapters.title: Chapter 201: Bigger Danger!
paragraphs: Ravian fell silent because he had no excuse to offer... but he was sure that the ants and all monsters hate the smell of the stinky mushrooms...
This is what his father had told him... so his father was wrong? Or is the smell of these mushrooms not bad enough?
Or could there be another reason? A reason that made the ants have no choice but to enter here...? A reason that made the ants not dare to turn back?
Does that mean something has trapped them here?
Lian looked at them with Night Eyes. The world around him became clearer.
The colored mist was no longer an obstacle. The movement of every leg, every antenna, and every small contraction in the ants’ bodies became clear to him.
Something was wrong. The ants were not looking at them.
A few Workers passed so close that their jaws could have reached Nemi’s feet, but they didn’t even turn their heads.
One of the Soldiers passed by the corpse of an ant that Lian had killed moments earlier, without reacting to the smell of blood.
Some were being crushed under the feet of their own kind, some were entering small cracks in their haste and falling.
There was no order in their attack.
This was not the behavior of predators chasing prey.
"They are not after us anymore. It seems something here has terrified them and disrupted their order." Lian said quietly.
"Huh? What could scare a whole colony? Is there something more terrifying than them here?" Sera, who was still breathing heavily, looked at him.

Lian did not answer immediately. The monsters had not shown fear before entering this place. He looked into the distance, as if the ants had noticed something and were rapidly moving away from the point they had entered from.
Could there be something there? Or had they sensed something?
Whatever it was, he was sure the ants were no longer after them... but rather they had just noticed something that made them want to leave this place.
He stared into the darkness behind the colony. No monster could be seen, no shadow was moving among the roots, but the ants’ behavior could only mean one thing.
"They are running away."
"From what?" Ravian quickly turned his head. He couldn’t understand what this massive colony might be afraid of or want to run from.
Lian did not answer.
Because at that same moment, Predator’s Instincts exploded in his mind.
The warning did not come from behind. Not from the sides, but from below: directly beneath their feet.
And it was extremely close! Very, very close!
"Damn it!"
"Get away from the ground!" Lian shouted.
The soil split open.
A round opening opened beneath one of the Workers.
Before the creature could react, a white, thick, and fleshy root shot out from the depths of the ground.
The root wrapped around the ant’s body, the Worker’s legs were slammed into the soil.
Its jaws opened and closed wildly, but the root pulled it into the opening with a violent movement.
The soil closed over its body, only one antenna remained outside for a moment, and then that too disappeared.
More openings opened on the ground’s surface, dozens of white roots emerged from all sides.
One wrapped around a Soldier’s leg, another pierced a Worker’s abdomen.
The third passed through the group of ants and pulled several bodies together like beads on a string.
At that same moment, the massive mushroom on their right moved. Its cap rose, but beneath it, there was no flat or bladed surface.
Hundreds of small, ring-like teeth opened inside a round opening. The opening opened with a wet sound, and the roots pulled several ants toward it.
The mushroom swallowed the armored bodies all at once.
The ring-like jaw closed, and the sound of shells crunching was heard from inside the stem.
"The mushrooms... are alive?" Nemi stepped back in fear.
"Not just alive, they are predators!" Ravian was staring at them.
The yellow and green mist suddenly became thicker. The caps of dozens of mushrooms trembled at the same time.
Clouds of toxic spores were released into the air, the surrounding space turned into a sea of colored vapor within seconds.
Sera took a step, but her knee bent, she placed her hand on the mushroom’s stem to keep from falling.
Nemi coughed twice and knelt down. Ravian also sank his spear into the ground.
The flow of mana around his body trembled several times and went out.
"This smell... it disrupts mana."
Lian held his breath. His body showed more resistance. Poison Foe had increased his resistance to this mist.
But he was not completely immune. A burning sensation reached his lungs, his vision at the edges was slightly blurred.
"Damn you Ravian, what kind of hell did you decide to bring us to?" He regretted having called that boy a tracker.
He immediately took out an anti-poison potion from his storage and consumed it.
[Poison resistance +5%]
Without hesitation, he took out five more from his stock of forty and consumed them. His condition gradually stabilized.
But they didn’t have much time. Their surroundings had turned into a three-way battlefield.
Crimson Needle Soldiers clamped their jaws on the white roots.
The roots were cut off, and a yellow liquid sprayed from their tissue.
The larger mushrooms were swallowing Workers.
The ants were climbing up their stems and piercing the soft tissue under the caps with their stingers.
Toxic spores were swirling in the air like living mist. The soil was rising and falling under the pressure of the roots.
One of the openings opened right under Ravian’s feet.
Lian pulled him back.
A white root shot out from the soil and split the exact spot where Ravian’s foot had been a moment before.
Ravian looked at Lian with gratitude upon seeing this scene. This man had saved him once again!
"I thought that bird’s nest was dangerous, it seems I was wrong."
This forest had a different way of killing for every type of predator.
"We have to get out of here, right now!" Sera said with difficulty.

chapters.title: Chapter 202: The Qeen Of Ants I
paragraphs: Lian checked the paths, everywhere was full of roots and ants, there was no direct path, not to mention them, even the ants were trapped here.
They could not stay here and had to leave this place as soon as possible, he could not be sure whether the situation would remain under control or not.

Of course, even now the situation was not that much under control, they had been lucky that the ants and plant monsters were only busy fighting each other and did not have the chance to pay much attention to them.
’But why? Why is the attention of the plant monsters more on the ants? Is there a reason?’ He thought to himself.
"Noooooo ahhhhh" and at that same time Nemi screamed, a white root had come out from under her foot and wrapped around her wrist.
Before he could decide, Nemi screamed, a white root had come out from under her foot and wrapped around her wrist.
Her feet left the ground, her body was dragged on the soil.
Sera reached her and wrapped both her arms around Nemi’s arm.
A second root shot out of the soil, this one wrapped around Nemi’s waist.
The pulling force multiplied, and Sera also fell to the ground.
Both were pulled toward a dark opening that was slowly opening in the soil, small teeth were moving inside the opening.
Lian ran toward them, a Soldier appeared in his path, he activated Glacial Reaper Claw without stopping.
The ice claw passed through the ant’s jaw, Lian jumped over its falling body, reached Nemi, and brought his hand down.
The ice claw cut the first root, a thick yellow liquid burst from the cut tissue, some of it splashed directly onto Lian’s face.
A severe burning sensation spread in his eyes, his vision turned white, and for a moment the world disappeared.
Predator’s Instincts screamed.
Lian lowered his head, a Soldier’s stinger passed over his head, without seeing, he moved his hand toward the sound.
The ice claw sank into the ant’s body, the creature fell beside him, Lian grabbed the second root with his other hand.
Diamond Skin formed on his fingers so the toxic tissue wouldn’t burn his skin.
He pulled the root, and Sera also pulled Nemi back.
The root resisted for a few moments, then Glacial Reaper Claw passed through it.
Both Lacerians fell to the ground, Lian wiped his face with his sleeve, and his vision slowly returned.
First shadows, then colors, then movement, at that same moment, a large Soldier passed by him.
Lian prepared to attack, but the ant didn’t even look at him, it ran straight toward the center of the area.
Another moved behind it.
Then a third.
Lian followed their gaze, dozens of Soldiers had gathered in a part of the battlefield.
Not for attack, but for protection, and among the red and black bodies, something white was moving.
Something large.
The Soldiers were carrying it on their backs and jaws.
Lian looked through the mist, it was a massive and semi-transparent object, like a soft and elongated egg whose surface was covered with dark veins.
Inside it, the shadow of a twisted creature could be seen.
Delicate legs, a swollen abdomen, and part of a head that had not yet fully formed.
"Did you say the colony attacked us for revenge for the rest of its members? Does this colony also include the Queen?" Lian looked at Ravian.
Ravian also saw it, and his face went blank for a moment from fear.
"The Queen..."
"Is that the Queen?" Sera stood up with difficulty.
"Normally, the Queen should be in a safe place, so she shouldn’t be with them, unless it’s a young Queen that hasn’t come out yet, or maybe..." Ravian nodded.
The truth was now clearer.
"If at least this time your information is correct, then I think I understand what’s going on." Lian sighed.
The colony had not followed them just to avenge the death of a few Workers.
Thousands of ants were migrating, the Soldiers had taken the immature Queen out of the nest, and the entire colony was moving around her.
Something had forced them to leave their home, something that even thousands of Crimson Needle Ants avoided facing.
A part of the ants that were moving ahead of the rest of the colony for surveillance had encountered Lian and those three and considered them a threat.
So they attacked them, but Lian killed them all, which made the colony angry and it instinctively chased after them for revenge.
And the result? They chased them all the way here, but when they realized what danger was here and wanted to retreat, it was too late.
The mushrooms had also awakened because of the massive energy inside the egg, and they had blocked all the exits, trapping everyone here.
For the colony, these carnivorous plants, the immature Queen was more than food, she was a condensed source of mana and life.
Dozens of roots moved toward the egg, the Soldiers clamped their jaws on the roots.
Some threw themselves in front of the attacks.
A root thicker than a human’s torso came out of the soil and threw three Soldiers into the air.
The second root wrapped around the egg.
The ants attacked it wildly, the stingers sank into the white tissue.
Yellow liquid sprayed, the third root came from the other side, and then the fourth.
The Queen’s egg was trapped among dozens of roots.
All the surrounding mushrooms opened their caps at the same time, the spores became so thick that the forest light faded.
Now that they were occupied, it was the best time to escape, and Lian checked the surroundings, the exit route was blocked, on the right, there was a wall of living mushrooms.
On the left, thousands of ants were passing, behind them, roots were coming out of the soil.
Ahead, the predator openings were also opening one after another, normal attacks were not enough.
Even if he cut every root with Glacial Reaper Claw, dozens of other roots would come out of the ground.
Thunder Calamity could also kill the ants, but wouldn’t stop the spores and mushrooms.
"All of you stay behind me." Lian looked at Ravian.
"What are you going to do?" Ravian breathed with difficulty.
"I’ll open a path."
Sera lifted Nemi.
"Whatever happens, don’t go outside the area I create." Lian made his tone harder, he also couldn’t predict how things would go.
The three Lacerians gathered behind him, Lian faced the battlefield and placed both his hands on the ground.
All the mana in his body started moving, not like a calm flow, but like a lake whose dam had broken.
Cold spread from the center of his chest, went down from his shoulders, moved along his arms, and entered the soil through his palms.
At first, only a thin layer of dew froze on the moss.
Then the air temperature dropped, Ravian and the two girls’ breaths turned into white vapor, the spores suspended in the air lost their speed.
They turned into small crystals one by one and fell to the ground like snow.
The moss turned white, a root that was coming toward Lian stopped in the middle of its movement.
A layer of ice started from its tip and spread along its entire length, the stem of the nearest mushroom cracked.
[Eternal Frozen Apocalypse]

chapters.title: Chapter 203: The Qeen Of Ants II
paragraphs: [ Eternal Fozen Apocalypse ]
The skill’s power wanted to explode in all directions.
It wanted to swallow the area, all the mushrooms, all the ants, and even Lian’s companions.
Lian clenched his teeth, forcefully kept the mana flow in a narrow path, and ice advanced from his hands in a straight tunnel.
The white wave moved through the moss, everything in its path froze.
A Worker running with open legs froze in place.
A Soldier that had raised its stinger remained motionless just like that.
The white roots turned into ice sculptures in the air, a massive mushroom turned white from the bottom to the top of its cap.
A moment later, the sound of cracking was heard from inside it, the stem collapsed.
The multi-ton mushroom cap fell to the ground with a loud sound and buried dozens of ants under it.
The ice wave went further.
The green and yellow hell of the forest turned into a white and silent corridor for a few seconds.
The spores no longer moved, the roots were frozen in place, the ants stood like fragile sculptures on both sides of the path.
Lian lifted his hands from the ground, his breathing was heavy, controlling the power had consumed more energy than releasing it.
[Warning! Your mana has reached emergency level!]
[Less than one percent of your mana remains!]
Of course, the cost was also high, and this freezing was not going to last forever.
In normal circumstances, because he had used the skill in a smaller area, his mana should not have reached such a critical and dangerous level.
But in the path he wanted to open, and right in front of them on that same path, there were a large number of plant monsters and a few ants.
And all of them were between levels 20 and 26, and freezing them required a huge amount of mana, which caused his mana to become almost completely drained.
The three siblings looked at the scene before them in shock... what they saw was something that could only come from the hands of legendary gods.
Was this Otherworldly a god...?
"Move!" Lian shouted.
Ravian ran first, Sera pulled Nemi along with her.
Lian moved behind them, every step they took on the ice layer made a cracking sound.
The frozen ants crumbled with the slightest contact, their bodies split into frozen pieces, the mushrooms on both sides of the tunnel were quietly cracking.
But the cold didn’t last forever, behind them, the ice on one of the roots broke.
A weak movement began inside it.
Lian increased his speed, the exit of the area could now be seen, a few dozen meters ahead, the colored mist was less, and a massive root opened the path toward another part of the forest.
"We’re almost there!" Ravian shouted.
The ground behind them trembled.
Lian immediately turned back, expecting something to come out of the darkness, but nothing appeared from behind, instead, a sound came from the center of the battlefield.
A very quiet crack, but clear in that frozen silence.
The Soldiers around the Queen’s egg stopped at the same time.
Those that were fighting the mushrooms separated their jaws from the roots, the Workers that were still running suddenly slowed down.
Thousands of antennae turned in one direction.
The Queen’s egg.
Another crack appeared on its white surface.
Then a third.
Something struck the shell from inside, not with the weak movement of an immature creature, but with calculated violence.
The dark veins on the egg contracted, the shell split from the center, and a thick black liquid spilled out from inside.
The nearby Soldiers didn’t step back, on the contrary, they got closer to the egg, the crack grew larger, thin legs came out from inside.
But those legs did not belong to an ant’s body, they were long and bony, their joints bent in unusual directions.
The tip of each leg was like a human finger, one of them grabbed the egg’s edge, then a second one came out.
Then several other legs.
A black and elongated creature crawled out of the Queen’s immature body.
It had no skin.
Its body surface was shiny and moist, as if it was made directly from raw meat.
Several legs had grown on both sides of its body, moving on the ground like long fingers.
It had no distinct head.
On the front of its body, there was only a vertical slit, the slit slowly opened, and inside it was absolute darkness.
The identification panel appeared before Lian’s view.
[Unknown Parasitic Lifeform]
[Level: ???]
[Detection Failed]
Lian kept his gaze fixed on the creature, the truth formed in his mind with cold clarity.
"How is such a thing possible?" No enemy had chased the colony.
The danger was from inside themselves, they were running from something that had grown inside the Queen.
Maybe they wanted to take her to a far point, maybe they intended to separate the infected Queen from the colony.
Or maybe they were only following a blind instinct that told them they had to move.
But it was too late.
The parasitic creature opened its vertical slit wider, no sound came out of it, however, Lian felt intense pressure in his ears.
"Ahhhhhhhh" as if a silent scream had exploded directly inside his skull.
The scream was so horrible that he felt his skull might shatter at any moment!
Ravian placed his hand on his head, Sera fell on one knee.
"Ahhhhhhh" Nemi let out a muffled scream.
Hundreds of ants trembled at the same time, first the nearby Workers, then the Soldiers, and then a wave of trembling spread through the entire colony.
The red eyes of the first ant went dark, their color turned to black, the second one also changed.
The third, and within seconds, hundreds of red points in the darkness went out and were replaced by black, lightless eyes.
The ants bowed toward the parasitic creature one after another, not like creatures paying respect to the Queen, but like limbs attaching to the main body.
The black creature raised one of its thin legs, and the entire colony turned at the same time.
This time, the antennae were pointed at Lian and his companions, there was no longer any aimless rush or escape in their movements.
Thousands of bodies lined up with perfect order.
Ravian looked at the sea of black-eyed ants, his voice truly trembled.
No... this wasn’t just a tremble, it was endless terror!
"It... is controlling all of them."
Sera stood up with difficulty, placing one hand on her wounded shoulder and wrapping the other around Nemi.
Nemi was still breathing with difficulty.
Lian stared at the parasitic creature, Predator’s Instincts was active.
And the danger warning was active at the highest possible level! The risk of death was almost certain!
At that same moment, the system’s light appeared before his eyes.
[Emergency Hidden Quest Generated.]
[Kill the Brood Parasite before full assimilation.]
[Time Remaining: 59:59]
[Failure Consequence: Birth of a New Colony-Type Calamity that can enter your world]
[This Quest was sent to all awakened ones present in the Special Area]
Thank you so much for all your support so far, it has given me the motivation to write Chapters every day.

sentences.text: [ Eternal Fozen Apocalypse ]
The skill’s power wanted to explode in all directions.
It wanted to swallow the area, all the mushrooms, all the ants, and even Lian’s companions.
Lian clenched his teeth, forcefully kept the mana flow in a narrow path, and ice advanced from his hands in a straight tunnel.
The white wave moved through the moss, everything in its path froze.
A Worker running with open legs froze in place.
A Soldier that had raised its stinger remained motionless just like that.
The white roots turned into ice sculptures in the air, a massive mushroom turned white from the bottom to the top of its cap.
A moment later, the sound of cracking was heard from inside it, the stem collapsed.
The multi-ton mushroom cap fell to the ground with a loud sound and buried dozens of ants under it.
The ice wave went further.
The green and yellow hell of the forest turned into a white and silent corridor for a few seconds.
The spores no longer moved, the roots were frozen in place, the ants stood like fragile sculptures on both sides of the path.
Lian lifted his hands from the ground, his breathing was heavy, controlling the power had consumed more energy than releasing it.
[Warning!
Your mana has reached emergency level!]
[Less than one percent of your mana remains!]
Of course, the cost was also high, and this freezing was not going to last forever.
In normal circumstances, because he had used the skill in a smaller area, his mana should not have reached such a critical and dangerous level.
But in the path he wanted to open, and right in front of them on that same path, there were a large number of plant monsters and a few ants.
And all of them were between levels 20 and 26, and freezing them required a huge amount of mana, which caused his mana to become almost completely drained.
The three siblings looked at the scene before them in shock... what they saw was something that could only come from the hands of legendary gods.
Was this Otherworldly a god...?
"Move!" Lian shouted.
Ravian ran first, Sera pulled Nemi along with her.
Lian moved behind them, every step they took on the ice layer made a cracking sound.
The frozen ants crumbled with the slightest contact, their bodies split into frozen pieces, the mushrooms on both sides of the tunnel were quietly cracking.
But the cold didn’t last forever, behind them, the ice on one of the roots broke.
A weak movement began inside it.
Lian increased his speed, the exit of the area could now be seen, a few dozen meters ahead, the colored mist was less, and a massive root opened the path toward another part of the forest.
"We’re almost there!" Ravian shouted.
The ground behind them trembled.
Lian immediately turned back, expecting something to come out of the darkness, but nothing appeared from behind, instead, a sound came from the center of the battlefield.
A very quiet crack, but clear in that frozen silence.
The Soldiers around the Queen’s egg stopped at the same time.
Those that were fighting the mushrooms separated their jaws from the roots, the Workers that were still running suddenly slowed down.
Thousands of antennae turned in one direction.
The Queen’s egg.
Another crack appeared on its white surface.
Then a third.
Something struck the shell from inside, not with the weak movement of an immature creature, but with calculated violence.
The dark veins on the egg contracted, the shell split from the center, and a thick black liquid spilled out from inside.
The nearby Soldiers didn’t step back, on the contrary, they got closer to the egg, the crack grew larger, thin legs came out from inside.
But those legs did not belong to an ant’s body, they were long and bony, their joints bent in unusual directions.
The tip of each leg was like a human finger, one of them grabbed the egg’s edge, then a second one came out.
Then several other legs.
A black and elongated creature crawled out of the Queen’s immature body.
It had no skin.
Its body surface was shiny and moist, as if it was made directly from raw meat.
Several legs had grown on both sides of its body, moving on the ground like long fingers.
It had no distinct head.
On the front of its body, there was only a vertical slit, the slit slowly opened, and inside it was absolute darkness.
The identification panel appeared before Lian’s view.
[Unknown Parasitic Lifeform]
[Level: ???]
[Detection Failed]
Lian kept his gaze fixed on the creature, the truth formed in his mind with cold clarity.
"How is such a thing possible?" No enemy had chased the colony.
The danger was from inside themselves, they were running from something that had grown inside the Queen.
Maybe they wanted to take her to a far point, maybe they intended to separate the infected Queen from the colony.
Or maybe they were only following a blind instinct that told them they had to move.
But it was too late.
The parasitic creature opened its vertical slit wider, no sound came out of it, however, Lian felt intense pressure in his ears.
"Ahhhhhhhh" as if a silent scream had exploded directly inside his skull.
The scream was so horrible that he felt his skull might shatter at any moment!
Ravian placed his hand on his head, Sera fell on one knee.
"Ahhhhhhh" Nemi let out a muffled scream.
Hundreds of ants trembled at the same time, first the nearby Workers, then the Soldiers, and then a wave of trembling spread through the entire colony.
The red eyes of the first ant went dark, their color turned to black, the second one also changed.
The third, and within seconds, hundreds of red points in the darkness went out and were replaced by black, lightless eyes.
The ants bowed toward the parasitic creature one after another, not like creatures paying respect to the Queen, but like limbs attaching to the main body.
The black creature raised one of its thin legs, and the entire colony turned at the same time.
This time, the antennae were pointed at Lian and his companions, there was no longer any aimless rush or escape in their movements.
Thousands of bodies lined up with perfect order.
Ravian looked at the sea of black-eyed ants, his voice truly trembled.
No... this wasn’t just a tremble, it was endless terror!
"It... is controlling all of them."
Sera stood up with difficulty, placing one hand on her wounded shoulder and wrapping the other around Nemi.
Nemi was still breathing with difficulty.
Lian stared at the parasitic creature, Predator’s Instincts was active.
And the danger warning was active at the highest possible level!
The risk of death was almost certain!
At that same moment, the system’s light appeared before his eyes.
[Emergency Hidden Quest Generated.]
[Kill the Brood Parasite before full assimilation.]
[Time Remaining: 59:59]
[Failure Consequence: Birth of a New Colony-Type Calamity that can enter your world]
[This Quest was sent to all awakened ones present in the Special Area]

chapters.title: Chapter 204: Emergency Hidden Quest
paragraphs: [Emergency Hidden Quest Generated.]
[Kill the Brood Parasite before full assimilation.]
[Time Remaining: 59:59]
[Failure Consequence: Birth of a New Colony-Type Calamity that can enter your world.]
[This Quest was sent to all awakened ones present in the Special Area.]
Hundreds of black-eyed ants were standing in front of him.
The wild disorder that could be seen in their movements a few moments ago had completely disappeared.
None of them were passing over another anymore.
No Worker was falling into a gap aimlessly, and no Soldier was blindly attacking the mushrooms with violence.
The entire colony had lined up in an unnatural silence.
Thousands of red and black bodies were placed next to each other like armor pieces of a single creature.
Their antennae were bent in one direction with perfect order, and all their black, lightless eyes were fixed on the four people standing at the end of the frozen corridor.
In the center of that armored sea, the parasitic creature was still attached to part of the Queen’s immature body.
The white shell of the egg was hanging from both sides of its body like torn skin.
Black threads had come out of the immature Queen’s abdomen and were connected to the parasite’s moist body.
Every time those threads contracted, the raw mass of flesh beneath the creature’s body trembled, and dark energy passed through it.
The identification panel before Lian’s view trembled.
The letters that were unclear a few moments ago slowly took shape.
[Black Brood Matriarch — Incomplete Form]
[Rank: Mutated]
[Level: 35]
[Threat Classification: Calamity Seed]
"A Mutated one?" he whispered to himself, this was not the first time he had encountered a Mutated one.
But it was definitely the strongest Mutated one he had ever seen, and Lian stared at Level 35 for a moment.
In normal circumstances, such a number would not force him to retreat.
But this battle was not normal.
His mana had dropped to less than one percent.
His lungs were still burning from the mushroom spores, and even though the potions and Poison Foe had helped to some extent, the poison was still in the air.
Behind him, Nemi was barely standing on her feet.
Her face had no color.
Her breaths were short and broken, and every time she coughed, her small body trembled in Sera’s arms.
Sera had wrapped one arm around her sister’s waist and was holding her own wounded shoulder with the other hand.
Blood had run down from under the wrapped cloth and reached her fingertips, but her gaze still did not separate from the Queen.
There was fear in her eyes, not a simple and involuntary fear, but a fear that came from fully understanding the situation.
She knew that even if Lian could kill dozens of ants, against thousands of controlled creatures, any mistake could lead to the death of all of them.
Ravian was also standing in front of his sisters.
He was holding his spear with both hands, but its tip was trembling slightly.
He had clenched his jaw so tightly that the muscles on the sides of his face stood out.
Then he looked at Lian, they were waiting for orders.
Lian closed the panel, the system’s light disappeared.
"We’re leaving." he then said.
Sera raised her head, and in her eyes there was a sign of understanding about the decision.
She could feel Lian’s mana, even someone who couldn’t see his panel could feel the dryness of the energy flow around his body.
Lian’s decision was ruthless and put his world’s lives at risk, but in the current situation, victory was not possible.
If he died right here, it wouldn’t matter which world the monsters entered.
The sentence was cold, but it was not ruthless, it was the truth.
He was not a hero who would throw away his life just because a mission appeared, nor was he a madman who would leave three wounded companions against a living army to maybe get a reward.
If there was a way to escape, escaping was the most logical decision.
Lian turned his gaze toward the massive root that, a few dozen meters away, opened the exit path from the mushroom area.
The ice on the corridor he had built was slowly cracking.
The frozen mushrooms on both sides of the path were still standing, but muffled sounds were coming from inside their stems.
The roots would be freed from the ice sooner or later.
They didn’t have much time, and Lian said quietly.
"Ravian, take Sera and Nemi."
"And you?" Ravian immediately answered.
"I’ll come behind you."
Lian stepped forward and they were ready to leave the place, but suddenly all the antennae turned toward Ravian and his two sisters.
He could use Abyss Veil skill to pass through the gaps and save himself, but his companions could not.
Of course, there was also a bigger problem, his cooldown was still not over, so he could not use it.
Ravian also understood a truth, his gaze fell on Lian for a moment.
Something between anger, helplessness, and shame formed on his face, he didn’t want to be a burden on Lian.
But now he was exactly that.
"Move." but Lian didn’t care.
Ravian led his sisters toward the exit.
Sera took Nemi from one side, and Ravian put his arm over her shoulder from the other side.
They started running.
At that same moment, the parasitic Queen raised one of her thin and bony legs.
The tip of that leg, like a long finger, sank into the soil.
A black vein spread from the point of contact, at first it was only a thin line, and then it spread across the entire ground like a network of blood vessels.
The black veins passed under the ice, moss, and corpses, and connected to the bodies of hundreds of ants.
The colony moved at the same time, Workers separated from both sides, and Soldiers climbed over the frozen corpses.
Within seconds, hundreds of ants rushed toward the exit path and climbed up from both sides of the massive root.
Their bodies piled on top of each other, one row, two rows, and then dozens of rows, a living and moving wall formed in front of the path.
Ravian was forced to stop, and Nemi looked at that wall, her eyes widening in terror.
"They... already knew where we were going."
Lian had also understood this, Predator’s Instincts was showing him the danger paths.
Every path they chose would be blocked before they reached it.
This creature did not just command, it saw.

Through thousands of eyes, from above the roots, from under the moss, from the cracks of the mushrooms, practically every ant was an eye, every antenna was a sensor, and every body was a limb of a larger being.
Because all the exit routes were blocked, they didn’t even have time to react, and before they could reach the exit, the path was already closed.
[Hive Mind Dominion]
The Queen was controlling the entire colony like a single body.
Hiding behind mushrooms or roots was useless, the entire area had eyes.
At that same moment, all the eyes turned toward Lian again, it was clear the Queen had noticed his presence and recognized him as the biggest threat.
Lian placed both his hands in front of his body, the tiny remaining mana gathered in his palm, and he slammed his palm on the ground.
[Cataclysm Pulse]
A compressed wave exploded from under the soil, the ground rose in front of him.
The first row of Workers was uprooted and thrown into the air.
The shell under their abdomen cracked, and a few heavier Soldiers fell on their sides.
The path was open for a few seconds.
"Run!"
Ravian pulled his sisters, the three passed through the gap that had been created.
Lian moved behind them, pushing away any ant that came close with a punch or a kick.
But they only went a few dozen meters forward, the black veins under the ground contracted again, and this time the ants moved from both the front and the back simultaneously.
Workers rushed toward Nemi, Soldiers surrounded Sera.
A few jumping ants came down from above the living wall and blocked Ravian’s path.
The Queen was not attacking Lian directly, she had targeted his three companions, she had understood that they were the point Lian could not ignore.
Sera deflected the first Worker’s jaw with her knife.
But her wounded shoulder could not handle a second strike, and another ant came from the right.
Ravian placed his spear between it and his sister.
The monster’s jaw closed on the wood, and the spear bent.
Ravian roared and pushed it back with all his weight, but a Soldier hit him from behind in the side.
He rolled a few meters on the ground.
Nemi screamed his name, and Lian appeared among them in an instant.
His right fist hit the Worker’s head, the shell cracked with a dry sound, and with his elbow, he broke the Soldier’s jaw.
Then he placed his foot on the creature’s chest and threw it toward the other two ants.
But the wave had no end.
"This was not what I expected, damn it." Lian wanted to curse with all his being, all his efforts had practically gone to waste.
He had not expected this Queen to be able to organize and control the entire colony with such speed, to organize those scattered ants, and to block all the paths.
First, the plant monsters had blocked the paths, and he had forcibly opened them, and now these damn ants.
And a large part of their escape plan was based on the ants and plant monsters being busy fighting each other.
That after the Queen was born, those monstrous plants hid in fear.
Lian turned his gaze back to the quest panel for a moment.
[Do you accept the Emergency Hidden Quest?]
Maybe he really had no choice...

chapters.title: Chapter 205: The Paralytic Bloodmist
paragraphs: Sera was standing in front of Nemi with her body, even though she could barely stay on her feet herself.
Nemi was terrified.
But she was still holding her short spear with both hands and trying to hide the trembling of her fingers.

Lian took a quiet breath, escaping was no longer a choice, even though he preferred to solve this matter by running away, as long as the Queen was alive, the colony would not allow any of them to leave the area.
"Then we have to cut off her head first." He touched the panel.
[Quest Accepted.]
[Time Remaining: 57:43]
At that same moment, the vertical slit on the Queen’s body opened, and a silent scream spread through the air.
Thousands of ants moved at the same time.
Lian reached his hand into his storage space, and a small blue crystal appeared between his fingers.
Emergency Mana Crystal.
The crystal was the size of a fingertip, but inside it, a luminous liquid was spinning like a compressed storm.
Lian pressed and broke it, suddenly the mana liquid entered his mouth, at the first moment, he felt nothing but sharp cold.
Then all the energy of the crystal exploded inside his body at once, and mana rushed into his almost-dried circuits like a wild flood.
The veins on his neck bulged, a burning pain ran from his chest to his shoulders and then to his fingertips.
His knees bent for a moment, he felt something inside tearing his mana channels.
He clenched his teeth and did not allow himself to fall on the ground.
Blue light passed from under his skin, a few mana veins appeared on his arms like shining cracks.
The sudden entry of a large amount of mana into the body naturally had its own side effects.
[Emergency Mana Crystal consumed.]
[520 Mana restored.]
[Current Mana: 525/650]
[Warning: Mana channels have entered an overloaded state.]
[Further excessive mana output may cause permanent damage.]
Lian let out a heavy breath, the power had returned, but the mana was flowing in his wounded channels like boiling water in cracked pipes.
However, this was enough, for now, this would have to do, besides, if it wasn’t enough, he could just increase his mana.
He opened his skill panel, his gaze fixed on Paralytic Venom.
Killing thousands of ants with fists was not impossible.
But before the end, the Queen could kill his companions or complete the assimilation process.
He needed a skill that could stop a large number of enemies at the same time.
[Would you like to consume 15 Skill Fragments to evolve Paralytic Venom?]
[Available Skill Fragments: 61]
Lian answered without pausing.
"Yes."
Fifteen Fragments were used immediately to upgrade the skill.
[Paralytic Venom has evolved.]
[New Skill Acquired.]
[Paralytic Bloodmist]
[Rank: Great]
The skill description appeared before his eyes.
[All the user’s blood and body fluids become infected with paralyzing poison.]

[The user can release a poisonous mist around himself by consuming blood and mana. The poison enters the target’s body through breathing, eyes, wounds, joints, or armor cracks and causes nervous system disruption, reduced muscle coordination, and gradual paralysis.]

[Any target hit by the poison has its power reduced by 10%, if the target is much weaker than the host, the power reduction will be 25%, and if the target is stronger than the user, the poison will work between 0% and 5%.]
[Consumes 8 mana per minute.]
[Remaining Skill Fragments: 46.]
"Good." He was satisfied with the upgrade, even if it was only at the level of weakening monsters, it would be a great help to him.
Then Lian opened his status panel.
[Power: 468]
[Spirit: 258]
[Speed: 300]
[Mana: 650]
[Resistance: 380]
[Available Status Points: 376]
Increasing only physical power was not enough, this battle needed control, speed, resistance, and more than anything, mana.
Lian distributed the points without hesitation.
[Mana +120]
[Spirit +70]
[Resistance +50]
[Speed +40]
[280 Status Points consumed.]
His stats changed before his view.
[Physical Strength: 468]
[Spirit: 328]
[Speed: 340]
[Mana: 770]
[Resistance: 430]
[Available Status Points: 96]
[Current Mana: 525/770]
The flow of mana inside his body expanded.
The increased capacity slightly reduced the pressure on his channels, but his current energy did not increase further.
Lian closed the panel.
"You... just became stronger?" Ravian, who was still standing in front of the wave of ants, looked at the change in mana pressure around him in disbelief.
His hunter’s intuition was warning him that this man had become even more dangerous than before!
But how? How could a person become stronger so quickly?
Of course, he did not understand, the reason was simple, the people of this small world did not have the same system as Lian and the other awakened ones, and their local power system was different.
Lian did not answer.
He put the tip of his index finger between his teeth and tore his skin.
Blood ran down from his finger, but before it could reach the ground, it evaporated, and a red and dark mist spread from around his hand.
[Paralytic Bloodmist]
The mist spread across the ground like a low cloud.
The first Workers entered it, at first nothing happened.
A few ants ran forward at the same speed.
Ravian looked at them with anxiety, Sera pulled Nemi further behind her.
Then one of the Worker’s legs trembled, its front joint locked up.
Its body turned to one side and fell on the ground, the second ant took two steps and suddenly all six of its legs folded.
The third tried to pass over them, but its movements slowed down, and its antennae moved irregularly.
The mist was working.
But the Soldiers were still coming forward, their thick armor would not let the poison enter the body quickly.
Lian slammed his sole on the ground and sent mana from his shin into the soil.
[Cataclysm Pulse]
The second wave exploded under the ants, this time the goal was not to kill, but the shell under the bodies of dozens of Soldiers cracked.
The joints opened, and fine cracks formed on their armor.
The red mist penetrated into them, and the first Soldier’s movement slowed down, its stinger stopped in the middle of being raised.
The second stumbled a few steps and fell on its side, the third was still resisting, but one of its back legs no longer obeyed.
Lian charged into the wave.
His right fist hit the first Worker’s head, the shell broke like a clay bowl.
Before the creature could hit the ground, Lian’s elbow sank into the joint of the nearby Soldier.
The leg separated from the body.
The ant opened its jaw, and Lian raised his knee, the strike hit the creature’s jaw from below and dislocated the metal jaw.
Another Soldier shot its stinger toward his chest.
Lian grabbed the dead ant’s body and held it like a shield in front of himself.
The stinger passed through the shell of its own kind.
Lian pushed the corpse forward, slammed it into the enemy, and then with a straight punch, crushed the front part of its head.
Dark blood and shell fragments scattered in the air.
Sera was staring at him.
The more she watched this scene, the more she realized the depth of this Otherworldly’s terrifying power...
And something in his fighting had changed.
He was no longer just fast, every movement was more calculated, more brutal, and more direct, his fists landed to break the hard points.
His elbows and knees hit the weak joints, he used the bodies of enemies to block the next stingers.
He was not fighting among them, he was turning them into tools to kill each other, and yet, their numbers were still increasing.
Lian took a few steps.
Electrical energy gathered in his legs, every movement stored more lightning in the muscles of his calves and thighs.
[Thunder Step activated.]
Sparks formed around his ankles, the next moment, his body disappeared, and an electrical explosion occurred at his previous location.
The nearby Workers trembled at the same time and fell on the ground.
Lian appeared a hundred meters ahead, a second explosion formed at his landing point, and the weaker ants were paralyzed for a moment.
But the level 23 and 24 Soldiers only slowed down for a fraction of a second.
That fraction of a second was enough, he crushed one Soldier with two punches.
He grabbed the second one by the abdomen and slammed it onto the third, then moved again.
Thunder Step was moving him through the army.
Every Dash brought the sound of air breaking and a thunderous explosion.
But the skill was not without cost, after the third Dash, the skin on his right calf cracked.
After the fourth, his muscles burned like hot threads.
Electrical energy was passing through his bones and creating a deep pressure in his knees.
Lian ignored the pain, his goal was to get close to the Queen, to kill that Queen, he had to get close to her first!
But the colony was ready for him every time before he appeared.
When the energy gathered in his legs, dozens of ants would predict the direction of his movement.
At the end of the Dash, Soldiers were already waiting for him, after the fifth movement, three stingers landed at the same time where he appeared.
Lian took the hits with Diamond Skin, but the impact force pushed him back a few steps.
His hardened skin did not scratch, but the muscles beneath it ached from the intensity of the hits.
The Queen was reading the path of Thunder Step, of course, this was what happened when you had thousands of eyes.
Hive Mind Dominion was analyzing all his movements.
Lian stepped back.
His gaze fell on Ravian and his sisters for a moment, another wave was approaching them, he could not both reach the Queen and protect those three at the same time.
He immediately took out one of the defensive Scrolls he had bought from his storage space and activated it by tearing it immediately.
A golden ring appeared under Ravian, Sera, and Nemi’s feet.
The light rose from the ground and closed around them in the form of a semi-transparent dome.
The first Worker hit the shield, the golden surface trembled, and the creature was thrown back, the front part of its shell burnt.
A few other ants hit the dome at the same time, and golden sparks spread across its entire surface.
But none of them could break the dome’s defensive line!

sentences.text: Sera was standing in front of Nemi with her body, even though she could barely stay on her feet herself.
Nemi was terrified.
But she was still holding her short spear with both hands and trying to hide the trembling of her fingers.

Lian took a quiet breath, escaping was no longer a choice, even though he preferred to solve this matter by running away, as long as the Queen was alive, the colony would not allow any of them to leave the area.
"Then we have to cut off her head first." He touched the panel.
[Quest Accepted.]
[Time Remaining: 57:43]
At that same moment, the vertical slit on the Queen’s body opened, and a silent scream spread through the air.
Thousands of ants moved at the same time.
Lian reached his hand into his storage space, and a small blue crystal appeared between his fingers.
Emergency Mana Crystal.
The crystal was the size of a fingertip, but inside it, a luminous liquid was spinning like a compressed storm.
Lian pressed and broke it, suddenly the mana liquid entered his mouth, at the first moment, he felt nothing but sharp cold.
Then all the energy of the crystal exploded inside his body at once, and mana rushed into his almost-dried circuits like a wild flood.
The veins on his neck bulged, a burning pain ran from his chest to his shoulders and then to his fingertips.
His knees bent for a moment, he felt something inside tearing his mana channels.
He clenched his teeth and did not allow himself to fall on the ground.
Blue light passed from under his skin, a few mana veins appeared on his arms like shining cracks.
The sudden entry of a large amount of mana into the body naturally had its own side effects.
[Emergency Mana Crystal consumed.]
[520 Mana restored.]
[Current Mana: 525/650]
[Warning: Mana channels have entered an overloaded state.]
[Further excessive mana output may cause permanent damage.]
Lian let out a heavy breath, the power had returned, but the mana was flowing in his wounded channels like boiling water in cracked pipes.
However, this was enough, for now, this would have to do, besides, if it wasn’t enough, he could just increase his mana.
He opened his skill panel, his gaze fixed on Paralytic Venom.
Killing thousands of ants with fists was not impossible.
But before the end, the Queen could kill his companions or complete the assimilation process.
He needed a skill that could stop a large number of enemies at the same time.
[Would you like to consume 15 Skill Fragments to evolve Paralytic Venom?]
[Available Skill Fragments: 61]
Lian answered without pausing.
"Yes."
Fifteen Fragments were used immediately to upgrade the skill.
[Paralytic Venom has evolved.]
[New Skill Acquired.]
[Paralytic Bloodmist]
[Rank: Great]
The skill description appeared before his eyes.
[All the user’s blood and body fluids become infected with paralyzing poison.]
[The user can release a poisonous mist around himself by consuming blood and mana.
The poison enters the target’s body through breathing, eyes, wounds, joints, or armor cracks and causes nervous system disruption, reduced muscle coordination, and gradual paralysis.]

[Any target hit by the poison has its power reduced by 10%, if the target is much weaker than the host, the power reduction will be 25%, and if the target is stronger than the user, the poison will work between 0% and 5%.]
[Consumes 8 mana per minute.]
[Remaining Skill Fragments: 46.]
"Good." He was satisfied with the upgrade, even if it was only at the level of weakening monsters, it would be a great help to him.
Then Lian opened his status panel.
[Power: 468]
[Spirit: 258]
[Speed: 300]
[Mana: 650]
[Resistance: 380]
[Available Status Points: 376]
Increasing only physical power was not enough, this battle needed control, speed, resistance, and more than anything, mana.
Lian distributed the points without hesitation.
[Mana +120]
[Spirit +70]
[Resistance +50]
[Speed +40]
[280 Status Points consumed.]
His stats changed before his view.
[Physical Strength: 468]
[Spirit: 328]
[Speed: 340]
[Mana: 770]
[Resistance: 430]
[Available Status Points: 96]
[Current Mana: 525/770]
The flow of mana inside his body expanded.
The increased capacity slightly reduced the pressure on his channels, but his current energy did not increase further.
Lian closed the panel.
"You... just became stronger?" Ravian, who was still standing in front of the wave of ants, looked at the change in mana pressure around him in disbelief.
His hunter’s intuition was warning him that this man had become even more dangerous than before!
But how?
How could a person become stronger so quickly?
Of course, he did not understand, the reason was simple, the people of this small world did not have the same system as Lian and the other awakened ones, and their local power system was different.
Lian did not answer.
He put the tip of his index finger between his teeth and tore his skin.
Blood ran down from his finger, but before it could reach the ground, it evaporated, and a red and dark mist spread from around his hand.

The mist spread across the ground like a low cloud.
The first Workers entered it, at first nothing happened.

chapters.title: Chapter 206: A Desperate Fight
paragraphs: The defensive Scroll that was used was a B-rank item and one of the best of that rank.
Although it is not absolute, it can at least protect those three from the ants for a short time, and unless the ants decide to attack the dome all at once, its defense will not break.
[Estimated duration under current assault: 08:43]
On the other side, Lian was still engaged, but his poisonous blood was helping him a lot and had allowed him to control the flow of the battle.
"8 minutes is enough, even if I don’t need 8 minutes, it’s good to not have to worry about them." He felt relieved and then looked at Ravian.
"As long as this shield is up, don’t come out of it."
"You can’t fight all of them alone." Ravian held his spear tighter.
Lian slammed a Soldier that had passed by the shield to the ground with a straight punch.
The creature’s head sank into the soil, and without looking at Ravian, he said.
"Being alone is not my problem, being forced to protect you is." And his second punch broke the shell on the back of the ant’s head.
The sentence landed like a cold blade, Nemi lowered her gaze, a pain deeper than fear formed in her eyes.
She tightened her fingers around her short spear.
"We were just a burden to you..."
"Now is not the time for this." Sera immediately squeezed her arm and tried to silence her sister.
But she herself was also hurt by Lian’s sentence, not because of its coldness, but because she knew it was the truth.
From the first moment they had seen this Otherworldly, he had been helping them while they were just extra weight.
Ravian was silent for a few moments, then pressed his back against the shield and fixed his gaze on Lian.
There was anger on his face, but not toward him, toward his own weakness.
"Then come back alive."
Lian did not answer, now that he had no worry about those three, the time had come to go after the Queen.
He moved in the shadow of a broken mushroom, Thunder Step was charged in his legs, he did not choose the direct path, he climbed over a root and changed his direction twice.
The ants were after him, but to prevent them from reaching him, he also activated [Fallen Wolf Speed] and his speed reached an extraordinary level.
"Oh haha, what a great feeling." Even he himself was somewhat surprised by his speed.
Then he Dashed, a thunder explosion occurred behind him, and this time the ants were not ready for him before he appeared.
He appeared a few meters away from the Queen, the black and moist body of the creature was in front of him, threads from it were connected to hundreds of ants.
He pulled his right fist back, and power gathered in his shoulder, arm, and knuckles.
Suddenly at that same time, the parasite’s body pulled back, and its vertical slit opened.
Lian’s fist moved, but before impact, a silent scream exploded inside his skull.
[Neural Scream]
The world turned white for a moment, a wild pain ran from his ears to his brain, his focus broke.
Blood started splashing from all his pores like a waterfall.
The fist’s path deviated a few centimeters and passed by the Queen’s body, the creature spun one of its long legs, and the strike hit Lian’s side.
Diamond Skin activated at the last moment.
His skin became defensive and transparent, but the force of the impact was beyond what surface resistance could stop.
Lian was lifted off the ground like a bullet, his body passed through two Workers, slammed into the stem of a frozen mushroom, and broke it.
Then he rolled several meters on the soil, a sharp pain twisted in his ribcage, two or three ribs were cracked, and warm blood came out of his mouth.
"Lian!" Behind the shield, Nemi screamed.
Sera lost her color.
For a moment, she moved toward the edge of the dome, but Ravian grabbed her hand.
"Don’t go out! He’s wounded! If we go out, he’ll have to protect us again!"
Sera clenched her teeth, her eyes filled with helplessness.
She was forced to stand and watch, for someone who had spent her entire life protecting her siblings, nothing was more painful than being useless.
Lian placed his hand on the ground, blood dripped from his lip onto the moss, and his heartbeat grew louder.
"Bastard is stronger than I expected, damn it." He still felt pain in his bones and let out a short groan.
"But it’s not bad either, it’s been a while since I had a battle like this." A smile appeared on his face.
The last time he had a real battle was with Seris, after that, he had won easily in every battle.
Except for the Abyssal River Drake, and that was not a battle, there he had no chance to fight.
But here it was different, finally after a long time, he could have a real battle! And for such a battle, he had to fight seriously from the start.
So instead of healing himself with a healing potion, he activated another skill.
[Warrior’s Madness activated.]
[Physical damage detected.]
[Power increased.]
[Speed increased.]
[Mental Corruption: 4%]
Lian calmly stood up, the pain was still there, but its form had changed.
The cracked ribs were no longer just a warning, they had turned into fuel, blood flowed through his body with more pressure, and his muscles became heavier and at the same time faster.
The sound of the ants’ jaws in his ears turned into a harsh melody.
His gaze fell on a nearby Worker, for a moment, he had the urge to tear its head off with his bare hands.
Not because it was necessary, but just because he wanted to hear the sound of its shell breaking.
Lian blinked, this was the same madness he felt when he activated this skill, it awakened all the animalistic and barbaric desires of a human!
Predator’s Instincts wrapped around his mind like a cold chain.
And the higher Spirit did not let the violent urge take control.
He breathed and calmed his mind, the target was the Queen, not these insects.
Nevertheless, the first Worker reached him, Lian punched, and the creature’s head completely exploded.
The second came from the left, he grabbed its jaw with his hand and pulled it in the opposite direction.
The shell split from the middle, and the third sank its stinger into his wounded side.
Diamond Skin activated late, the tip of the stinger entered his skin a few millimeters.
A burning pain spread through his body, and at the same time, Warrior’s Madness responded.
[Additional damage detected.]
[Strength increased.]
[Mental Corruption: 7%]
A brief smile settled on Lian’s face, which even he himself was not aware of.
He pulled the stinger out of his body, grabbed the Soldier by its tail, and slammed it to the ground with all his strength, the shell under its abdomen cracked.
Lian placed his foot on its head and pressed down, the sound of armor crushing spread under his sole, and system panels appeared one after another.
[You have killed 37 Crimson Needle Workers.]
[You have killed 9 Crimson Needle Soldiers.]
[Butcher has accumulated sufficient stats points.]
Lian started moving again, Thunder Step carried him through the wave.
Each thunder explosion paralyzed a few Workers, he killed them at the landing point with fists and elbows.
The dead ants piled up, but the black threads from the Queen’s body came out and connected to the corpses, the broken shells began to tremble.
Dark blood and internal tissue were pulled out of the bodies and moved along the threads toward the Queen.
The corpses dried up within seconds, the parasite’s body grew larger, and layers of black armor formed on its moist surface.
Two new legs came out from its sides.
[Black Assimilation]
[Assimilation Progress: 12%]
Lian frowned, killing ants near the Queen was feeding it, he changed his path and drew the enemy wave away from the center.
But the Queen also changed her method, her vertical slit opened, and a few nearby Workers suddenly bent their bodies.
A black liquid entered their abdomens through the connected threads, their shells swelled.
Predator’s Instincts screamed.
Lian immediately activated Thunder Step, and at that same moment, the ants exploded.
[Queen’s Command: Sacrifice]
The biological explosion covered the area, shell fragments like blades were thrown in the air, and black and poisonous liquid splashed on the ground.
"This bitch massacred her own forces? Is she insane?" Lian appeared a hundred meters away, but the explosion wave still hit his back, a few fragments sank into his shoulder and thigh.
Diamond Skin stopped most of them, but two pieces passed through a point where the armor was not complete.
Blood spread on his clothes.
[Additional damage detected.]
[Power increased.]
[Speed increased.]
[Mental Corruption: 11%]
The pressure of Warrior’s Madness in his mind increased, the sound of his heartbeat was now louder than all the sounds of the battle.
He wanted to enter the explosion again, he wanted to pass through the blood and body parts and crush everything in his path.
The madness was taking more and more control of him!
But at that same time, Neural Scream was activated again and replaced his madness with pain!
A sharp pain exploded behind his eyes, he knelt on one knee, and the focus of Paralytic Bloodmist was disrupted for a moment.
The red mist around him scattered, the Queen had understood how to interrupt his skills.
Lian opened the status panel, without more Spirit, the next scream could completely immobilize him.
[Spirit +40]
[Mana +40]
[Resistance +16]
[Physical Strength +50]
[146 Status Points consumed.]
His stats changed.
[Strength: 518]
[Spirit: 368]
[Speed: 344]
[Mana: 810]
[Resistance: 448]
[Available Status Points: 103]
[Current Mana: 467/810]
The pain in his skull decreased, not completely, but enough for him to stand up again.
Another panel appeared.
[You have killed 42 Crimson Needle Workers.]
[You have killed 11 Crimson Needle Soldiers.]
[Butcher has accumulated sufficient attributes.]
The current mana had not changed relative to the new cap.
[Current Mana: 472/815]
Lian reactivated Paralytic Bloodmist, this time the red mist spread thicker through the wave.
Hundreds of Workers entered it, their legs trembled, and some fell at that same moment, the Soldiers slowed down.
But the Queen raised one of her legs, black threads connected to several hundred ants.
Their bodies changed, their breathing openings on their sides closed, and the flow of their internal fluid slowed down.
Their shells were covered with a greasy layer.
[Rapid Brood Mutation]
[The enemy has developed temporary resistance to Paralytic Bloodmist.]
The ants that were falling a moment ago moved again, slower than before, but not enough to matter.
"What? How? How did they become resistant so quickly? Fuck it."
Lian looked at the wave that was still attacking Ravian and the other two from all sides.
The shield’s time had decreased.
[Estimated duration under current assault: 03:18]
And this meant that at any moment, his worry about those three could return, and the pressure on him would multiply again!

Dark blood and internal tissue were pulled out of the bodies and moved along the threads toward the Queen.
The corpses dried up within seconds, the parasite’s body grew larger, and layers of black armor formed on its moist surface.
Two new legs came out from its sides.
[Black Assimilation]
[Assimilation Progress: 12%]
Lian frowned, killing ants near the Queen was feeding it, he changed his path and drew the enemy wave away from the center.
But the Queen also changed her method, her vertical slit opened, and a few nearby Workers suddenly bent their bodies.
A black liquid entered their abdomens through the connected threads, their shells swelled.
Predator’s Instincts screamed.
Lian immediately activated Thunder Step, and at that same moment, the ants exploded.
[Queen’s Command: Sacrifice]
The biological explosion covered the area, shell fragments like blades were thrown in the air, and black and poisonous liquid splashed on the ground.
"This bitch massacred her own forces?
Is she insane?" Lian appeared a hundred meters away, but the explosion wave still hit his back, a few fragments sank into his shoulder and thigh.
Diamond Skin stopped most of them, but two pieces passed through a point where the armor was not complete.
Blood spread on his clothes.
[Additional damage detected.]
[Power increased.]
[Speed increased.]
[Mental Corruption: 11%]
The pressure of Warrior’s Madness in his mind increased, the sound of his heartbeat was now louder than all the sounds of the battle.
He wanted to enter the explosion again, he wanted to pass through the blood and body parts and crush everything in his path.
The madness was taking more and more control of him!
But at that same time, Neural Scream was activated again and replaced his madness with pain!
A sharp pain exploded behind his eyes, he knelt on one knee, and the focus of Paralytic Bloodmist was disrupted for a moment.
The red mist around him scattered, the Queen had understood how to interrupt his skills.
Lian opened the status panel, without more Spirit, the next scream could completely immobilize him.
[Spirit +40]
[Mana +40]
[Resistance +16]
[Physical Strength +50]
[146 Status Points consumed.]
His stats changed.
[Strength: 518]
[Spirit: 368]
[Speed: 344]
[Mana: 810]
[Resistance: 448]
[Available Status Points: 103]
[Current Mana: 467/810]
The pain in his skull decreased, not completely, but enough for him to stand up again.
Another panel appeared.
[You have killed 42 Crimson Needle Workers.]
[You have killed 11 Crimson Needle Soldiers.]
[Butcher has accumulated sufficient attributes.]
The current mana had not changed relative to the new cap.
[Current Mana: 472/815]
Lian reactivated Paralytic Bloodmist, this time the red mist spread thicker through the wave.
Hundreds of Workers entered it, their legs trembled, and some fell at that same moment, the Soldiers slowed down.
But the Queen raised one of her legs, black threads connected to several hundred ants.
Their bodies changed, their breathing openings on their sides closed, and the flow of their internal fluid slowed down.
Their shells were covered with a greasy layer.
[Rapid Brood Mutation]
[The enemy has developed temporary resistance to Paralytic Bloodmist.]
The ants that were falling a moment ago moved again, slower than before, but not enough to matter.
"What?
How?
How did they become resistant so quickly?
Fuck it."
Lian looked at the wave that was still attacking Ravian and the other two from all sides.
The shield’s time had decreased.
[Estimated duration under current assault: 03:18]
And this meant that at any moment, his worry about those three could return, and the pressure on him would multiply again!

chapters.title: Chapter 207: Battle With The Qeen I
paragraphs: Nemi was kneeling behind the dome, her eyes fixed on Lian, and every time more blood spilled from his body, her face would tighten.
Sera, despite her weakness, kept her hand on her sister’s shoulder.
But she herself was also trembling.
Ravian said nothing.
He only watched the battle, and every time Lian took a hit, his fingers around his spear turned whiter.
He had understood that Lian was no longer fighting for himself. If he was alone, maybe he could still find a way to escape.
But now, every second he stayed on the field was to keep them alive.
This truth created something heavy in Ravian’s chest.
Not just shame, but a commitment. If they got out of here alive, this debt would not end with a simple thank you.
For all three of them, Lian was no longer just a simple Otherworldly, but like a real older brother.
On the other hand, Lian was completely unaware of their thoughts, and if he knew, he would only think they were overthinking. He was fighting because there was no way to escape.
If there was a way to escape, they would have escaped by now.
Then he opened the skill panel.
Paralytic Bloodmist was not enough. The Queen could change the army, she could close the ways the poison entered.
Great Rank against an enemy that was rewriting the colony’s biology itself only created a delay.
This skill was a great help to him, and he didn’t want to let it become useless. If it became useless, he would lose one of the advantages that allowed him to control the battle’s flow.
So he had only one choice.
[Available Skill Fragments: 46]
[Would you like to consume 40 Skill Fragments to evolve Paralytic Bloodmist?]
Lian kept his gaze fixed on the Queen.
"Yes."
Forty Fragments lit up.
[Paralytic Bloodmist has evolved.]
[Divine-Rank Skill Acquired.]
[Bloodborne Calamity Domain]
[Rank: Divine Rank]

The user’s blood, breath, and mana transform into a living calamity. By consuming blood and mana, the user creates a poisonous domain in which the poison bonds with the air, ground, moisture, and the surrounding mana flow. All creatures inside the domain become poisoned through contact with mana and the environment, without needing to breathe or have wounds.
Covers a radius of up to 1 kilometer, and any target weaker than the user has all its stats suppressed by up to 35%.
Any target with power equal to or stronger than the host has all its stats suppressed by up to 5%.
Consumes 60 units of mana per minute.
[Remaining Skill Fragments: 6.]
Lian took a quiet breath, but it was not really quiet. The result of the upgrade was much, much better than what he had expected.
Now with this skill, he could once again take full control of the battle’s flow, and with just one look, he could say that this skill from now on would be among his top 3 skills.
But this skill could not stay active for long, its mana consumption was very high, one of the highest mana costs of all his skills.
And it didn’t need to stay active for long, it only needed to break the wave and open a path between himself and the Queen.
He placed his wounded palm on the ground, blood flowed from between his fingers.
But instead of sinking into the soil, it spread in all directions in the form of red veins.
The moss took color from below, the air’s moisture turned red, and a heavy red mist rose from the ground.
[Bloodborne Calamity Domain]
[Excluded Targets: Ravian, Sera, Nemi.]
The domain opened.
The first row of Workers entered it, this time there was no delay.
Their legs trembled at that same moment, their antennae fell, the weak mana flow in their bodies was disrupted.
The first ant took three steps and fell on the ground, the second was still trying to move when all its joints locked up.
The third died while running, its body swelled and then exploded, not a large explosion, but a dense cloud of red poison burst from its body and sprayed over the surrounding ants.
They also became infected.
The second wave began.
Every corpse became a carrier, every death created dozens of new contaminations, a chain effect spread through the colony.
Dozens of Workers fell.
Then hundreds, the stronger Soldiers resisted, but their speed was halved, and their legs were no longer coordinated, their stingers deviated in the middle of their movement.
For the first time, the sea of ants was pushed back.
"The mist... is it from his blood?" Nemi was looking at the field with wide eyes.
Sera said nothing.
Her face was caught between horror and awe, what she was seeing no longer looked like the power of a human, this was power that only gods should have!
Lian’s blood was contaminating the ground, the air was turning to poison by his command, and the monsters were falling one after another without even reaching him.
"This power..." Ravian said under his breath, and his body trembled in fear, just looking at it was enough to make the hairs on his body stand on end.
He had no words to describe it.
The Queen sent Black Assimilation threads toward the corpses, hundreds of black strands connected to the dead ants’ bodies.
The biomass started moving, but this time, the poison was also with it, the black threads turned red for a moment.
The Queen trembled, and her vertical slit opened violently, a black liquid spilled from inside it.
A few threads burst in the middle of absorption, and finally, the creature stepped back!
Lian saw it, the poison had entered the main body through the colony, the path to victory was this!
The Queen was poisoning herself by absorbing the infected ants.
[Black Brood Matriarch has been afflicted by Bloodborne Calamity.]
[Neural coordination reduced.]
[Assimilation efficiency reduced.]
Now was the best time for a major counterattack.
Lian activated Thunder Step, lightning gathered around his legs, and he disappeared in an instant.
A thunder explosion occurred among the paralyzed ants, their bodies were thrown into the air.
Lian, at the landing point, punched a Soldier’s head and sank it into the soil.
Second Dash.
Another explosion and three paralyzed Workers were crushed.
Third Dash.
The skin on his shins cracked more, blood ran down, but Warrior’s Madness responded to every damage.
[Additional damage detected.]
[Power increased.]
[Speed increased.]
[Mental Corruption: 18%]
[Current Mana: 319/815]
[Bloodborne Calamity Domain remains active.]
A short laugh came from Lian’s throat, this time he heard it himself, the sound of the laugh was strange.
Harsher, deeper, and for a moment, he had the urge to fill the entire domain with corpses.
He chose the direct path... the Queen and only the Queen!
Lian covered hundreds of meters in an instant with another Dash, a thunder explosion occurred in front of the creature, the guard ants were paralyzed.
He appeared among them, his fist hit one of the Queen’s bony legs, and the sound of breaking was heard.
The leg bent from the middle, black liquid sprayed out, and the Queen stepped back.
Lian sent his second fist toward her vertical slit, but suddenly hundreds of Soldiers rose from all sides.
Their bodies piled on top of each other, a living layer formed between his fist and the main body, Lian’s strike crushed dozens of ants, but did not reach the parasite.
More Soldiers climbed from the ground.
They stuck to the Queen’s body, their legs locked together, their jaws connected to each other’s shells, thousands of armored bodies gathered on top of each other.
"What the hell are they doing?" Lian said in disbelief upon seeing that scene.
[Black Brood Matriarch has activated Brood Carapace.]
[Assimilation Progress: 41%]
The Queen’s body grew, five meters, eight meters, and then over fifteen meters!
A massive mass of fused ants rose like living armor in front of Lian.
Six armored arms protruded from its sides, each arm made of hundreds of bodies whose legs and jaws were still moving.
In the center of the mass, a black vertical slit opened, and several hundred ant mouths produced sound at the same time.
The Queen’s voice did not come from one throat, it came from the entire colony.
"HOST... FOUND."
"What the fuck?" Lian remained motionless for a moment.
Black threads came out from the living armor, and thousands of thin strands twisted in the air, some as thick as hair, some like veins.
And all of them were aimed at him.
At the same time, the system panel appeared with red light!
[Warning!]
[The Black Brood Matriarch has selected you as its Prime Host.]
[If Parasite Thread reaches your heart, assimilation will become irreversible.]
Behind the shield, Nemi let out a muffled scream of terror, Sera unconsciously stepped forward and placed her hand on the golden surface of the dome.
"Lian... come back." Her voice was so quiet that he could not hear it.
Ravian stared at the fifteen-meter mass, the color had drained from his face.
He could feel that if those threads entered Lian’s body, none of them would be able to save him.
[Estimated duration under current assault: 01:26]
On the other hand, little time remained until the shield’s end!
Lian raised his fists, lightning gathered around his legs, blood dripped from his mouth, fingers, and the cracks on his shins onto the ground.
Bloodborne Calamity Domain was still swirling around him, and Warrior’s Madness was roaring in his veins.
In front of him, thousands of black threads opened in the air like a wave of snakes.
The pressure of madness increased in his mind, but this time he did not push it back, he only held its leash.
"You want my body? Then come and try." A cold and bloody smile settled on his face.
