chapters.title: Chapter 208: Battle With The Qeen II
paragraphs: Thousands of black threads shot out from the Black Brood Matriarch’s massive body.
They did not move like simple, straight whips.
Each thread split into several branches in the air, changed its path, passed by the ant corpses, and approached Lian from a new angle.
Some came down from above his head, some crawled on the ground, and another group came out from the cracks in the Queen’s living armor to block his retreat path.
Within seconds, the entire space in front of Lian was filled with a network of black veins.
The Queen did not intend to only kill him. She wanted him, his body, his heart, and everything hidden inside that human body.
The red light of the system panel trembled before Lian’s eyes.
[Warning! The Black Brood Matriarch has selected you as its Prime Host.]
[If Parasite Thread reaches your heart, assimilation will become irreversible.]
Upon seeing the panel, he frowned deeply, he did not expect to suddenly become the favorite target of a monster... how exactly did this happen?
What did that damn thing like about him? Unfortunately, now was not the time to complain.
Lian planted his feet firmly on the ground, and compressed lightning shone in the muscles of his shins.
[Thunder Step]
The world around him stretched for a moment.
The sound of thunder exploded at his standing point, and his body disappeared from among the threads.
A few Parasite Threads that had converged at his previous point burned in the electrical explosion.
The threads twisted, their surfaces cracked, and a black liquid spilled from inside them onto the frozen moss.
Lian appeared dozens of meters away, a second explosion formed beneath his feet.
A few half-paralyzed Workers that were trapped in the range of Bloodborne Calamity Domain were thrown into the air, and their shells broke against each other.
But before Lian could take the next step, new threads came down from both sides.
They knew his landing point because of the thousands of black eyes that followed his every move.
Hive Mind Dominion was still active, and the Queen did not look at him from the perspective of one creature.
She saw him from behind thousands of eyes, from above dozens of roots, from the cracks of mushrooms, and from beneath the ant corpses.
Wherever there was an ant, the Queen had an eye there, like an incredibly powerful and advanced surveillance system.
This surveillance system allowed the Queen to see and monitor thousands of different points at the same time.
Lian Dashed again, this time to the left, and thunder exploded among the ants, the black threads twisted at his landing point.
Third Dash.
Lightning, broken shells, red mist, and again.
Fourth Dash.
Lian bent his body before fully appearing, and one of the threads passed over his head.
Behind Nemi and Sera, with every time he disappeared, they held their breath. What they were seeing were scenes they could not even imagine in their wildest nightmares.
Their eyes darted between the lightning explosions, and every time Lian appeared a few moments later, their hearts ached with worry.
Their main fear was no longer the ants, but that one of those explosions would occur and Lian would not emerge from the light.
Sera placed her healthy palm on the golden surface of the shield.
The thin cracks on the dome had increased, and every time a few Workers hit it, the dome’s light would dim for a moment.
The shield’s time panel was floating.
[Estimated Duration: 01:08]
Sera bit her lip, her wounded shoulder was burning with pain, but her gaze did not leave the field.
Ravian, unlike the other two, said nothing. He had lowered his spear and was only examining the movement of the Queen’s massive body.
His eyes were on the armored arms, the joints, and the threads that reached from the center of the parasite’s body to the ant layers.
He could not compete with Lian in power, but maybe he could still see something that was hidden from Lian’s view in all that chaos.
Lian activated Thunder Step for the fifth time, lightning compressed in his legs.
The cracked skin on his shins split more, and warm blood ran down his ankles.
He disappeared, but this time one of the threads passed through the lightning explosion before the movement was complete.
Its surface burned, but it was not cut. The thread wrapped around Lian’s left wrist like a black snake.
He appeared at the landing point and immediately pulled his hand, but the thread slid on his hardened skin with strange force.
Diamond Skin was preventing its penetration, but the Parasite Thread did not intend to enter from that point.
It moved on his skin, following the blood, following the cracks, following one of the open wounds.
Two other threads stuck to his shin and shoulder. One passed through the crack in his shin’s skin, the other reached the wound on his shoulder.
"Fuck this shit." He felt a cold sensation enter his body.
[Parasite Thread has established contact.]
[Foreign neural signal detected.]
Lian’s left hand suddenly left his control, the muscles of his arm contracted without his will, and his fist turned back toward his own face instead of moving toward the Queen.
"Bastard, what kind of power is this?" Lian grabbed his left wrist with his right hand at the last moment.
The strike stopped a few centimeters before hitting his jaw.
The veins on his arm bulged, two different forces fought within one limb, his own will and a foreign command.
"You thought it would be that easy?" Lian clenched his teeth.
He was not going to lose to this bitch Queen.
Lightning formed inside his body, directly in his mana channels, between his muscles and bones.
[Thunder Calamity]
Lightning transferred from his shoulder to his arm and then to the threads attached to his body.
The Parasite Threads began to tremble, their black surfaces split, and the smell of burnt flesh spread in the air.
But the lightning did not only burn them, it also passed through Lian’s wounds, his muscles contracted violently.
"Ughhhhhh" His jaw locked, blood sprayed from the wounds, and for a moment, his heart lost its rhythm.
Then it beat again with a heavier strike, the threads burned one after another and separated from his body, but the pain from the lightning and internal damage awakened another flame inside him.
[Self-inflicted damage detected.]
[Warrior’s Madness has strengthened.]
[Power increased.]
[Speed increased.]
[Mental Corruption: 24%]
Lian’s heartbeat grew louder, the sounds around him became muffled, the smell of blood and burning became stronger in his nostrils.
Something inside his mind wanted to go straight into the mass of threads instead of retreating and tear everything apart with bare hands.
Madness!
Madness!
Madness!
This was the madness that was taking over the warrior’s mind!
Lian took a deep breath, he was still in control, but Warrior’s Madness was no longer just power, it was moving like a hungry creature behind his thoughts.
He charged toward the Queen again, his first fist hit the living armor of Brood Carapace.
Dozens of shells broke under the strike, a few Soldiers were crushed, and their dark blood splashed on Lian’s face.
But before his second fist could hit the same point, fresh ants came up from all sides and filled the gap.
Lian sank his elbow into the new layer, again dozens of bodies were crushed.
But the armor regenerated, the Queen was literally covering herself with the flesh of her army.
’One of the most annoying defensive skills I’ve ever seen, as a Queen, she has no shame in using her soldiers as victims and living shields.’ Lian jumped back.
He had fought many monsters, but this one undoubtedly had the strongest defense, a defense that practically had no way to penetrate.
And this was considering that his offensive skills had penetration power.
Bloodborne Calamity Domain was still active, the red mist was swirling around the field and consuming more of his mana every second.
[Current Mana: 241/815]
The ants inside the domain were being paralyzed and falling one after another, but the Queen was still pulling the healthier corpses onto her body.
Lian attacked the armor again.
Punch.
Elbow.
Knee.
Every strike destroyed several ants, but none reached the main body.
[Current Mana: 211/815]
He could not destroy Brood Carapace layer by layer.
Not before his mana ran out, not before the companions’ shield collapsed, and not before Assimilation was completed.
Behind the golden dome, Ravian suddenly saw something. The Queen raised one of her large armored arms to catch Lian from the side.
When the joint bent, the ants at the connection point separated for a moment. In the gap between them, thick black threads could be seen.
Not the thin Parasite Threads, but a main bundle, like nerves that transmitted movement commands to the entire arm.
"Lian!" Ravian stepped closer to the shield’s surface.
He might have finally found a way to help Lian.
Although his voice was lost under the roar of the colony.
The Queen lowered her arm, Lian dodged with Thunder Step, and the massive arm slammed into the ground.
The impact wave threw corpses and moss into the air.
"Under the left arm! When it moves, the armor opens!" Ravian shouted with all his might this time.
Lian turned his head toward him for a moment.
"The main threads enter the ants’ bodies from there!" Ravian pointed at the joint with his spear.
Lian turned his gaze back to the point Ravian was indicating. The Queen was folding her arm again, the ants shifted.
The gap opened only for a moment, but it was enough.
His eyes sparkled! He understood the structure.
The outer ants were only armor, the black neural threads held them together, and the parasite’s main body was hidden in the center of that structure.
If the main threads were cut, part of Brood Carapace could no longer maintain its shape.
He looked at the remaining shield time.
[Estimated Duration: 00:47]
Golden cracks had spread across the dome’s surface.
"Whatever you’re going to do, do it quickly." Sera said briefly and tensely. The dome that was protecting them was also approaching its end moment by moment!
Lian fixed his gaze on the Queen’s right leg. He withdrew Bloodborne Calamity Domain from its wide state.
The red mist around the field pulled back. Instead of covering several hundred meters, all the poison concentrated in a narrow area around the Queen’s right leg.
The air’s color changed from light red to dark, thick crimson. The ants forming the leg began to tremble.
Their legs locked on top of each other, a few Soldiers fell.
And finally, the massive structure’s balance was disrupted for a moment!

sentences.text: Thousands of black threads shot out from the Black Brood Matriarch’s massive body.
They did not move like simple, straight whips.
Each thread split into several branches in the air, changed its path, passed by the ant corpses, and approached Lian from a new angle.
Some came down from above his head, some crawled on the ground, and another group came out from the cracks in the Queen’s living armor to block his retreat path.
Within seconds, the entire space in front of Lian was filled with a network of black veins.
The Queen did not intend to only kill him.
She wanted him, his body, his heart, and everything hidden inside that human body.
The red light of the system panel trembled before Lian’s eyes.
[Warning!
The Black Brood Matriarch has selected you as its Prime Host.]
[If Parasite Thread reaches your heart, assimilation will become irreversible.]
Upon seeing the panel, he frowned deeply, he did not expect to suddenly become the favorite target of a monster... how exactly did this happen?
What did that damn thing like about him?
Unfortunately, now was not the time to complain.
Lian planted his feet firmly on the ground, and compressed lightning shone in the muscles of his shins.
[Thunder Step]
The world around him stretched for a moment.
The sound of thunder exploded at his standing point, and his body disappeared from among the threads.
A few Parasite Threads that had converged at his previous point burned in the electrical explosion.
The threads twisted, their surfaces cracked, and a black liquid spilled from inside them onto the frozen moss.
Lian appeared dozens of meters away, a second explosion formed beneath his feet.
A few half-paralyzed Workers that were trapped in the range of Bloodborne Calamity Domain were thrown into the air, and their shells broke against each other.
But before Lian could take the next step, new threads came down from both sides.
They knew his landing point because of the thousands of black eyes that followed his every move.
Hive Mind Dominion was still active, and the Queen did not look at him from the perspective of one creature.
She saw him from behind thousands of eyes, from above dozens of roots, from the cracks of mushrooms, and from beneath the ant corpses.
Wherever there was an ant, the Queen had an eye there, like an incredibly powerful and advanced surveillance system.
This surveillance system allowed the Queen to see and monitor thousands of different points at the same time.
Lian Dashed again, this time to the left, and thunder exploded among the ants, the black threads twisted at his landing point.
Third Dash.
Lightning, broken shells, red mist, and again.
Fourth Dash.
Lian bent his body before fully appearing, and one of the threads passed over his head.
Behind Nemi and Sera, with every time he disappeared, they held their breath.
What they were seeing were scenes they could not even imagine in their wildest nightmares.
Their eyes darted between the lightning explosions, and every time Lian appeared a few moments later, their hearts ached with worry.
Their main fear was no longer the ants, but that one of those explosions would occur and Lian would not emerge from the light.
Sera placed her healthy palm on the golden surface of the shield.
The thin cracks on the dome had increased, and every time a few Workers hit it, the dome’s light would dim for a moment.
The shield’s time panel was floating.
[Estimated Duration: 01:08]
Sera bit her lip, her wounded shoulder was burning with pain, but her gaze did not leave the field.
Ravian, unlike the other two, said nothing.
He had lowered his spear and was only examining the movement of the Queen’s massive body.
His eyes were on the armored arms, the joints, and the threads that reached from the center of the parasite’s body to the ant layers.
He could not compete with Lian in power, but maybe he could still see something that was hidden from Lian’s view in all that chaos.
Lian activated Thunder Step for the fifth time, lightning compressed in his legs.
The cracked skin on his shins split more, and warm blood ran down his ankles.
He disappeared, but this time one of the threads passed through the lightning explosion before the movement was complete.
Its surface burned, but it was not cut.
The thread wrapped around Lian’s left wrist like a black snake.
He appeared at the landing point and immediately pulled his hand, but the thread slid on his hardened skin with strange force.
Diamond Skin was preventing its penetration, but the Parasite Thread did not intend to enter from that point.
It moved on his skin, following the blood, following the cracks, following one of the open wounds.
Two other threads stuck to his shin and shoulder.
One passed through the crack in his shin’s skin, the other reached the wound on his shoulder.
"Fuck this shit." He felt a cold sensation enter his body.
[Parasite Thread has established contact.]
[Foreign neural signal detected.]
Lian’s left hand suddenly left his control, the muscles of his arm contracted without his will, and his fist turned back toward his own face instead of moving toward the Queen.
"Bastard, what kind of power is this?" Lian grabbed his left wrist with his right hand at the last moment.
The strike stopped a few centimeters before hitting his jaw.
The veins on his arm bulged, two different forces fought within one limb, his own will and a foreign command.
"You thought it would be that easy?" Lian clenched his teeth.
He was not going to lose to this bitch Queen.
Lightning formed inside his body, directly in his mana channels, between his muscles and bones.
[Thunder Calamity]
Lightning transferred from his shoulder to his arm and then to the threads attached to his body.
The Parasite Threads began to tremble, their black surfaces split, and the smell of burnt flesh spread in the air.
But the lightning did not only burn them, it also passed through Lian’s wounds, his muscles contracted violently.
"Ughhhhhh" His jaw locked, blood sprayed from the wounds, and for a moment, his heart lost its rhythm.
Then it beat again with a heavier strike, the threads burned one after another and separated from his body, but the pain from the lightning and internal damage awakened another flame inside him.
[Self-inflicted damage detected.]
[Warrior’s Madness has strengthened.]
[Power increased.]
[Speed increased.]
[Mental Corruption: 24%]
Lian’s heartbeat grew louder, the sounds around him became muffled, the smell of blood and burning became stronger in his nostrils.
Something inside his mind wanted to go straight into the mass of threads instead of retreating and tear everything apart with bare hands.
Madness!
Madness!
Madness!
This was the madness that was taking over the warrior’s mind!
Lian took a deep breath, he was still in control, but Warrior’s Madness was no longer just power, it was moving like a hungry creature behind his thoughts.
He charged toward the Queen again, his first fist hit the living armor of Brood Carapace.
Dozens of shells broke under the strike, a few Soldiers were crushed, and their dark blood splashed on Lian’s face.
But before his second fist could hit the same point, fresh ants came up from all sides and filled the gap.
Lian sank his elbow into the new layer, again dozens of bodies were crushed.
But the armor regenerated, the Queen was literally covering herself with the flesh of her army.
’One of the most annoying defensive skills I’ve ever seen, as a Queen, she has no shame in using her soldiers as victims and living shields.’ Lian jumped back.
He had fought many monsters, but this one undoubtedly had the strongest defense, a defense that practically had no way to penetrate.
And this was considering that his offensive skills had penetration power.
Bloodborne Calamity Domain was still active, the red mist was swirling around the field and consuming more of his mana every second.
[Current Mana: 241/815]
The ants inside the domain were being paralyzed and falling one after another, but the Queen was still pulling the healthier corpses onto her body.
Lian attacked the armor again.
Punch.
Elbow.
Knee.
Every strike destroyed several ants, but none reached the main body.
[Current Mana: 211/815]
He could not destroy Brood Carapace layer by layer.
Not before his mana ran out, not before the companions’ shield collapsed, and not before Assimilation was completed.
Behind the golden dome, Ravian suddenly saw something.
The Queen raised one of her large armored arms to catch Lian from the side.
When the joint bent, the ants at the connection point separated for a moment.
In the gap between them, thick black threads could be seen.
Not the thin Parasite Threads, but a main bundle, like nerves that transmitted movement commands to the entire arm.
"Lian!" Ravian stepped closer to the shield’s surface.
He might have finally found a way to help Lian.
Although his voice was lost under the roar of the colony.
The Queen lowered her arm, Lian dodged with Thunder Step, and the massive arm slammed into the ground.
The impact wave threw corpses and moss into the air.
"Under the left arm!
When it moves, the armor opens!" Ravian shouted with all his might this time.
Lian turned his head toward him for a moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 209: Battle With The Qeen III
paragraphs: Lian did not miss the opportunity, and at the same time, the Queen shifted her weight to the other side.
Lian ran to the right.
Hive Mind Dominion saw his path, dozens of black eyes turned in that same direction.
The Queen brought her left arm down with all her force to block his way, exactly what Lian wanted. Now the joint was fully open.
The ants separated from each other, the main threads were exposed, and lightning gathered in Lian’s legs.
How could he miss such a good opportunity to deal damage?
[Thunder Step]
He Dashed to the right, the Queen sent all her threads and arms to that point.
But Lian, before the movement ended, slammed his sole on the shell of a Soldier that was in his path.
The energy of Thunder Step was still flowing in his muscles, he changed the movement path in the middle of the Dash.
His body turned at an unnatural angle, the muscles of his right calf tore under the pressure.
The sound of bone cracking from inside his leg reached his ears, a white and sharp pain ran up to his thigh.
But the new path was formed. Lian entered the gap under the left arm directly from an angle that Hive Mind had not predicted.
The armored ants closed on top of each other, the forest light disappeared, he sank inside the Brood Carapace.
It was not absolute darkness. Red and black mana veins were moving in the tight space.
Hundreds of legs were crawling around him, jaws were opening and closing from a few centimeters away.
The ants’ bodies were stuck to each other like living walls, and black threads passed through their joints.
The smell of blood, acid, venom, and rotten flesh filled the suffocating space, there was no room for normal movement.
"It’s like a world of filth." Everywhere Lian reached his hand, he hit a shell or a leg.
Bloodborne Calamity Domain became dense in that enclosed space.
The red mist had no way to spread, it got trapped among the stuck bodies and its concentration multiplied. The first ant right next to Lian’s face was paralyzed.
Its legs folded, and all its weight fell on his shoulder. The second fell from above, the third was still resisting and clamped its jaw on Lian’s forearm.
Diamond Skin prevented his hand from being severed, but the pressure of the jaw penetrated to the bone.
"Ughhhhhhh" Lian crushed the creature’s head with his free fist, the shell split, and dark liquid splashed on his face.
Two other ants clung to his back from behind, a stinger hit his side.
Diamond Skin deflected part of the impact, but the pressure slammed his body between the shells.
Lian struck backward with his elbow, the sound of something breaking was heard, then he raised his knee and bent the Worker in front of him in half.
He was opening his path with fists, elbows, knees, and shoulders. Every strike crushed a body.
Every step landed on a broken shell, but every dead ant opened more space for the rest.
Jaws were grabbing his hardened skin from all sides, legs were wrapping around his limbs, the collective pressure of them was greater than the strike of a single monster.
His muscles were bruising under his skin armor, his cracked bones burned with every movement.
[Multiple physical injuries detected.]
[Warrior’s Madness has strengthened.]
[Power increased.]
[Speed increased.]
[Mental Corruption: 31%]
The sound of breaking shells echoed in the enclosed space, warm blood spilled on his fists.
Another ant approached him, and Lian sank his hand into the creature’s open jaw and pulled the two parts of its mouth apart.
The shell split with a harsh sound.
Then another.
Punch.
Breaking.
Another.
Elbow.
Blood.
Another.
Knee.
Sound of death.
The main goal faded from his mind. For a few seconds, nothing remained but destroying those living bodies.
Warrior’s Madness was burning behind his eyes. Every death made the urge to kill the next one stronger.
His mind was warning him that he was slowly losing his rationality, but the warning was fading among the sound of his heartbeat and the sound of crushing armor.
He currently had no time to listen to any warnings, it was not the time or the moment. This was his only chance to defeat this Queen.
If he failed, it would be the end for all of them!
Lian grabbed a half-paralyzed Worker and slammed its head against the living wall several times.
The first time the shell cracked, the second time blood burst out, the third time it was no longer necessary.
But he raised his hand for a fourth strike, and from a distance, a weak voice reached his ears.
"Lian!"
Nemi.
The voice had passed through several layers of ants and living armor, so weak that it could almost be mistaken for imagination.
But it was enough.
Lian’s hand stopped in the middle of the movement, his breathing was heavy.
His eyes fixed for a moment on the crushed corpse in front of him. He had not entered the armor to kill these ants, but he was venting his madness on them!
"At this rate, I’m slowly losing my rationality and I don’t even understand what I’m doing." His frown deepened.
He remembered his goal, the heart of the colony, the Queen.
Lian released the corpse. Predator’s Instincts showed the direction of danger again.
He followed the path of the black threads. In the depth of the Brood Carapace, a thick bundle of them, like a spine, was passing through the ants’ bodies.
Every time the threads contracted, the entire living wall also moved.
Lian moved forward, two Soldiers blocked his path. His first fist crushed one’s leg joint, and with his shoulder, he slammed into the second’s chest, sinking it into the wall.
Then he wrapped both his hands around the main thread bundle. At that same moment, the black strands moved.
Their tips, like needles, passed through the cracks of Diamond Skin and entered his open wounds.
"Damn it, not again!" A terrible cold entered his blood.
[Parasite Thread has entered the bloodstream.]
[Assimilation attempt detected.]
[Distance to heart: 34 centimeters.]
Lian’s right hand went completely numb for a moment, his fingers slipped off the threads, and part of his vision went black.
Then images entered his mind. Not one image, thousands of images. He simultaneously saw himself from above the roots.
From beside the dome, from among the moss, from under the dead bodies, from behind himself, from inside the darkness of the armor. Sight from thousands of angles entered his brain.
The differences in distance, sounds, and directions lost their meaning.
For a moment, Lian did not know which body belonged to him, which eye was real, which hand should move. His mind was breaking under the pressure of the network.
"So this is how the Queen sees? Her visual system? How does her brain handle it?" He really wanted to scream but controlled himself.
Seeing thousands of images at the same time was not something his brain could handle right now. Such a thing required much stronger Spirit.
The Queen had entered him and was taking full control of his body!
But the connection was not one-way. Among thousands of neural paths, Lian saw the main command flow. All the threads ultimately reached one point.
The center of the Brood Carapace.
Behind three dense layers of armored ants, where the parasite’s main body and its core were hidden.
"I found you." A bloody smile settled on Lian’s lips. All the pain he had endured was worth it!
He locked his numb hand around the threads again. Lightning formed inside his body, not to destroy one thread, but to burn the entire network.
He had to consume a large part of his mana, but he had no better choice!
[Thunder Calamity]
Electricity directly entered the neural column, the black threads shone with blue light, and the current jumped from one branch to the next.
From one ant’s body to another, from one arm to the legs, from the legs to the armor, and from the armor to the entire colony.
Outside the Brood Carapace, thousands of Crimson Needle Ants trembled at the same time.
Their black eyes went dark for a moment, their legs bent, some fell on the ground, some stood still without moving, and the Queen’s massive body lost its balance.
"Die, you bitch!" The main threads in Lian’s hands burned and burst.
Brood Carapace began to collapse. Hundreds of ants separated from the body.
The forest light entered the dark space through the cracks. A large part of the living armor fell to the ground with a loud crash.
"Ughhhhhhhh" The Queen screamed in rage!
At the same time, the defensive shield’s time approached zero.
The golden surface of the dome cracked from dozens of points.
Ravian raised his spear and stood in front of his sisters.
Sera, despite her wounded shoulder, pulled out her knife, and Nemi held her short spear with both hands.
The golden dome shattered.
Pieces of light scattered in the air like shining glass and then disappeared.
A few Workers that were still moving on instinct rushed toward them.
Ravian thrust the tip of his spear into the first ant’s mouth and deflected it to the side with all his weight.
Sera stepped forward and sank her knife into the second ant’s leg joint.
Her wounded shoulder trembled under the pressure, but she completed the strike.
Nemi, seeing a half-paralyzed Worker coming from beside her brother, swallowed her fear and held the spear’s tip against its stinger.
The impact pushed her hands back, but the stinger was deflected. Ravian immediately slammed the creature’s head to the ground with the butt of his spear.
They could stop a few confused and half-paralyzed enemies, but if Hive Mind was still active, they wouldn’t survive even a few seconds.
Finally, the remaining armor of the Queen collapsed. The main body was exposed. The parasite was no longer that slender and moist creature that had crawled out of the egg.
Black Assimilation had changed it.
Its body was several meters long, and incomplete layers of black armor had grown on its surface.
Its bony legs were thicker, and its vertical slit now extended like a massive mouth from its chest to its abdomen.
But the assimilation was unstable. Parts of the armor on its body were trembling, and the cut threads were twitching aimlessly.
Bloodborne Calamity poison was passing through its tissue and creating red veins on its black body.
The Queen understood that her time was coming to an end. Her vertical slit opened to its maximum, and all the corpses and living ants around started moving.
[Black Brood Matriarch has activated Colony Rebirth.]
[Assimilation Progress forcibly accelerated.]
The corpses rose from the ground, and blood and tissue were pulled from the dead bodies, flowing toward the Queen like dark rivers.
The living ants were also being dragged on the ground against their will, their legs creating scratches on the soil.
Some were still resisting, but the black threads were swallowing them.
The Queen ruthlessly wanted to complete the Assimilation Progress by sacrificing the entire colony! And this could end in a disaster!

Her vertical slit opened to its maximum, and all the corpses and living ants around started moving.
[Black Brood Matriarch has activated Colony Rebirth.]
[Assimilation Progress forcibly accelerated.]
The corpses rose from the ground, and blood and tissue were pulled from the dead bodies, flowing toward the Queen like dark rivers.
The living ants were also being dragged on the ground against their will, their legs creating scratches on the soil.
Some were still resisting, but the black threads were swallowing them.
The Queen ruthlessly wanted to complete the Assimilation Progress by sacrificing the entire colony!
And this could end in a disaster!

chapters.title: Chapter 210: Battle With The Qeen IV
paragraphs: Even the infected corpses entered the Queen’s body, and along with them, the Divine Rank poison.
The Queen’s body grew, new armor formed on its surface, but before it could fully complete, it cracked from the inside.
A new leg came out from its side, but a few seconds later, under the effect of the poison, it became paralyzed and fell to the ground. Black masses built on top of each other and then collapsed.
The Queen was becoming stronger and closer to death at the same time. Beneath her body, a black circle formed.
Unknown lines appeared on the soil and opened like a mouth to another world.
"I can’t let this quest fail, under any circumstances!" Lian whispered to himself upon seeing what this monster was turning into.
This was no longer just a quest, not just saving Ravian and his two sisters. That creature could actually find a way into his world.
If he escaped today and the Queen completed the process, maybe next time, thousands and hundreds of thousands of Crimson Needle Ants would pour out of a rift in the center of a human city.
Maybe he is not a hero, but he cannot allow millions of innocent people to be killed either.
He had seen with his own eyes what fate had befallen the border city after it was attacked by monsters.
If this Queen found a way into their world, with her massive army under her control, she could create an even greater hell and massacre millions.
Lian kept Bloodborne Calamity Domain active, his mana was dropping at a dangerous speed.
[Current Mana: 43/815]
The red veins of the domain became fainter, and his breathing was heavy.
[Current Mana: 31/815]
[Warning: Mana approaching critical level.]
He could no longer use Eternal Frozen Apocalypse, even another Thunder Calamity could completely destroy his mana channels.
The Queen felt this weakness. She raised her last healthy armored arm, and the massive mass descended on Lian with the sound of hundreds of jaws closing.
Lian had no chance to escape. He activated Diamond Skin with all his power.
The arm hit his body, the ground beneath his feet exploded, his body sank into the soil, and a wave of moss and shell fragments scattered around.
The impact pressure passed through his hardened skin. One of his cracked ribs completely broke, the tip of the bone pressed against the internal tissue.
Blood gushed from his mouth.
[Warrior’s Madness has strengthened.]
[Power increased.]
[Speed increased.]
[Mental Corruption: 39%]
Lian remained in the crater. The sounds around him became distant again.
Pain was everywhere, in his leg, ribcage, arm, mana channels, but behind that pain, a wild power was gathering.
Warrior’s Madness wanted to take the reins from his hand.
It wanted him to get up without thinking, burn all his mana, and attack until either he or the enemy was torn apart.
Lian looked at the Queen. Her massive body was trembling on the black circle, the poison was flowing in her tissue, her armor was regenerating.
Maybe the best thing really was to let the madness take control of everything?
But before that...
[Solar Forge Aegis]
A magma armor covered his entire body.
He had not activated this skill until now because he wanted to use the damage to strengthen Warrior’s Madness.
But his body could no longer endure it. If he took more damage, he might actually collapse.
But this was not enough. To defeat the Queen, he had to become even stronger!
[Stats Points: 305]
This was the amount he had obtained from killing all the ants present, and the time had come to use them.
[Strength: 518 --> 618]
[Stats Points: 14]
"Let me see what madness looks like." He whispered to himself, and a cold smile appeared on his lips.
At the same time, he let go of himself...
[Madness Corruption has taken over the host’s entire mind!]
[Warning! Warning! Warning!]
[Madness has taken over the host’s mind!]
The core was pulsing in the center of his body. All sounds went silent.
Not literally, but Lian’s mind was no longer processing them.
Not the sound of the ants, not the distant screams, not the breaking of mushrooms, only the hunt remained.
The flow of mana in the Queen’s body became visible before him like bright veins.
He could see the movement of the poison, feel the contraction of muscles before the attack, and recognize the cracks in the armor.
Every escape route and every defensive angle formed in his mind.
The pain faded. Warrior’s Madness did not turn off, but instead of becoming an aimless flame, it turned into a focused blade, into something that was no longer controllable...
The only target was the Queen’s death.
Lian came out of the crater, gathering the remaining lightning in his legs.
[Thunder Step]
He disappeared. The Queen’s armored arm passed over his head. Lian appeared at another point and Dashed again before the threads could reach him.
He passed through dozens of Parasite Threads.
One of the threads tore his side, blood sprayed in the air, but the madness did not even allow his gaze to deviate.
The core, only the core!
Lightning gathered in his legs for the last time. The torn muscles screamed, the cracked bone in his shin bent under the pressure.
Lian activated the final Dash.
The thunder explosion lit up the entire area. He appeared right in front of the Queen’s main body, the distance was less than a meter.
The creature’s vertical slit opened.
Neural Scream was released at close range. The mental pressure hit Lian’s skull directly.
Blood came out of his ears, the veins in his nose tore, part of his vision turned red.
But the madness had locked his focus!
Madness was practically acting like an extremely powerful drug! A drug that had intensely focused him on his target!
His right fist went back. All the base power, the increases from Warrior’s Madness, the speed from Thunder Step, and together with Glacial Reaper Claw.
All gathered in one point.
The fist landed. The outer layer of the Queen’s armor exploded, dozens of black pieces scattered around.
But the strike did not reach the core. Three inner layers still remained. The bones of Lian’s hand broke in several places.
His knuckles were crushed, his wrist bent, but he did not stop!
Thousands of Parasite Threads rushed toward his chest. Lian brought his left hand forward, the threads wrapped around his arm.
He deliberately allowed their tips to enter his wounds. The black strands sank into his muscles and climbed up from his arm.
But they did not reach his heart. Lian held them back with his left hand. His broken right hand went back again.

This time he activated Iron Fortress Charge. The skill’s energy rose from his sole, passed through his cracked shin, gathered in his thigh, waist, and shoulder, and his entire body became a channel for transferring force.
[Iron Fortress Charge]
Lian took a short step forward. The explosive force was transferred from the ground to his broken fist.
The second strike landed. The inner armor cracked, and Lian’s fist passed through the shell, the black tissue, and the infected flesh.
Dark blood splashed up to his shoulder. His hand sank into the Queen’s body. His broken fingers touched a hard and pulsing object.
Parasite Core.
The Queen produced a real sound, not a silent scream, but a loud and piercing screech that came from her entire body and the remaining ants at the same time.
"Ughhhhhhhhhhhhhh"
The threads in Lian’s left arm went deeper. Their coldness passed from his shoulder and reached his chest.
[Assimilation has reached the heart’s outer membrane.]

chapters.title: Chapter 211: Battle With The Qeen ( Final )
paragraphs: [Assimilation has reached the heart’s outer membrane.]
The muscles of his left hand lost control. His heart beat irregularly for a moment. The vision of thousands of ants rushed into his mind again.
The Queen tried to take over his body before death, but Lian’s right hand was closed around the core. The object was pulsing in his fingers.
Hard, fast, and anxious. Lian brought his bloody face close to the Queen’s vertical slit.
"You’re too late." He closed his fingers. The core cracked, and the Queen screamed.
But Lian did not stop and applied more pressure. The Parasite Core was crushed inside his broken fist.
All the black threads stopped moving at the same time, then dried up. Those inside Lian’s arm shriveled like burned veins.
The black eyes of the remaining ants returned to their natural red color for a moment.
Then their light went out. The bodies fell to the ground one after another. The black circle under the Queen trembled.
The dark space collapsed in on itself and disappeared with a muffled sound. The Black Brood Matriarch’s massive body cracked from the inside.
Bloodborne Calamity spread through all the connected biomass.
The newly formed armors swelled. Red veins came out from the cracks.
Then the Queen’s entire body collapsed. In her final moments, she stared at Lian with absolute hatred and rage, as if she wanted to tear him apart with her own hands!
Why?
Why?
Why?
Why did she have to face this human? All her efforts, all her ambitions, everything was destroyed by this bastard human!
Her entire colony was destroyed! And now she herself was collapsing!
If it weren’t for this human! If this bastard human had not interfered! She could have reached the peak without any problem.
"Ughhhhhhhhhh" She screamed her final scream of hatred before death... but it was too late.
Lian fell out of the black mass.
His foot could not bear his weight when it hit the ground, and he landed on his knee.
He had no healthy hand to hold himself up, so his shoulder hit the soil, and his body fell among the contaminated moss.
For a few seconds, nothing moved.
Ravian took a step forward. Sera placed her hand in front of his chest.
"Wait." Her eyes were on the collapsed mass of the Queen, they still did not know if the creature was completely dead or not.
"Lian..." Nemi could not wait.
Her voice trembled, but no answer came. She took a step forward.
[You have killed Black Brood Matriarch — Level 35.]
[You have destroyed a Calamity Seed.]
[Emergency Hidden Quest completed.]
[An enormous amount of experience has been absorbed.]
[As quest reward, you have obtained 100 stats points + 50 fragments and an extra life.]
A wave of energy entered Lian’s body.
[Level Up.]
A cold light spread from inside his bones. The bleeding on his side stopped. The broken rib was fixed in a stable position.
The dried parasite threads inside his arm began to burn. The open wounds on his skin closed. The cracks on his shins and torn muscles were fully healed, and the bleeding stopped.
His consciousness returned from the edge of shutdown, and the final message appeared before his half-open eyes.
[You have reached Level 18.]
His body moved away from death, but the pain remained. His mana, which had been drained, was refilled after the level up.
And the pressure of Warrior’s Madness, after turning off, collapsed on his mind all at once.
Lian took a broken breath. The next panels appeared.
[You have obtained 36 stats points.]
Lian could not even check the final stats. Even though his entire body had been healed, he was mentally exhausted.
He had just experienced the most difficult battle of his life. He had to fight a level 35 monster and thousands of giant ants.
Has any other awakened one ever been able to achieve such a feat before their first evolution?
If the world witnessed this battle, they would be shocked and amazed, thinking they were having a nightmare.
Because the potential shown in this battle was enough for everyone to understand that this boy had the ability to destroy all the pillars of humanity that had stood for years.
Pillars built by the most powerful awakened ones, pillars that were the source of their power, and pillars that had established their rule over the world.
No one likes someone who can single-handedly disrupt the balance and equality.
Maybe the Queen was not the real disaster... but Lian was a disaster that was slowly taking shape!
[Glutton activated.]
[High-grade genetic essence detected.]
[Skill extraction failed.]
[Target’s abilities are inseparably connected to its racial structure.]
[Alternative extraction available.]
[Talent detected.]
A dark light came out from the remains of the monster’s crushed core.
Instead of entering Lian’s body directly, it spread in the air for a moment in the form of a network of silver threads.
Thousands of small points lit up in that network, each point connected to another, with information of distance, position, sight, and presence flowing among them.
Then the entire network sank into Lian’s chest.
[Talent detected: Mother Of Colony]
[Rank: S]
Nemi did not wait any longer. She ran toward Lian and knelt beside him. She brought her hand forward, but stopped before touching his bloody body.
She did not know which part was intact. Almost nowhere looked intact, of course, only from the outside.
They did not know that awakened ones heal all their wounds after every level up.
"Lian?" Her voice turned into a whisper, worry was completely evident.
Sera arrived a few moments later. Despite the pain in her shoulder, she sat next to him and placed two fingers on Lian’s neck.
And she was surprised by the result. This boy’s pulse was completely steady and calm, without any problems.
But how? How could his pulse be so steady and calm after such a battle?
However, that didn’t matter now... the short breath she had been holding in her chest for a long time finally came out.
Her shoulders dropped for a moment, and relief was visible in her eyes.
"He’s alive." That was enough, just that their savior was alive was enough.
Nemi lowered her head, her eyes were wet, but she did not let the tears fall.
Ravian stood a few steps away, looking around.
Thousands of ant corpses, frozen and broken mushrooms, reddened moss with poison, craters left from lightning explosions and Lian’s strikes.
And in the center of all of it, the collapsed body of a creature that could have become a Calamity.
If his tribe’s people were here and witnessed this battle, they would choose Lian as their tribe’s god.
"Nothing can ever repay what he has done. We owe him our entire lives." He then said quietly.
Not just once, but this Otherworldly had saved their lives twice! This was no longer a debt they could repay in this lifetime.
"So for now... just help us get out of here." Lian opened his eyes slightly. His gaze was still blurry. His bloody lips moved with difficulty.
His head fell back on the moss. Nemi called his name, but this time Sera placed her hand on her sister’s shoulder.
"He’s just unconscious." The mental and spiritual pressure on him was too much, and losing consciousness was predictable.
In the distance, under the remains of a broken mushroom, one of the Crimson Needle Workers was still alive.
One of its legs was cut off, and its shell was cracked in several places. The creature slowly raised its head.
Its red eyes trembled for a moment, then their color changed.
Not to the Queen’s black, but to a cold silver shine. At that same moment, deep in Lian’s unconscious mind, a small point lit up.
A location, a pair of eyes, and the first weak link of a new colony...

chapters.title: Chapter 212: After The Battle
paragraphs: Lian woke up with a vague headache.
At first, he could see nothing but darkness.

The ceiling was so close that when he tried to raise his head, his forehead hit the hard and moist surface above him. The surrounding space was too tight for him to sit up fully, so he had to turn his body slightly to the side and keep his head down.
The smell of wet soil and moss was in the air.
The faint sound of water dripping from somewhere deep in the crack could be heard, and a cold breeze was entering through the narrow opening.
Lian breathed quietly a few times.
In the first moments, the pain behind his eyes intensified. As if the echo and pressure of Warrior’s Madness were still in his skull, pressing like a heavy ring around his mind.
But the headache gradually faded, and his eyes adjusted to the darkness.
Ravian was sitting near the crack’s entrance.

He held his spear on his knee and was watching the outside through the strands of moss that hid the entrance. His sitting posture and sharp ears showed that even while resting, he remained fully alert.
Sera was leaning against the root wall a few steps away.
Her eyes were closed, but her breathing was too light for deep sleep. A fresh cloth was wrapped around her wounded shoulder, and a dark stain of blood could be seen on it.
Nemi was curled up in a corner.
She had pulled her knees to her chest and wrapped her tail around her body. Her head rested on her arms, and unlike her sister, she seemed to be truly asleep.
Lian moved a little, and the sound of his clothes rubbing against the soil made Ravian immediately turn his head.
His hand unconsciously tightened on his spear, but when he saw Lian was awake, the tension left his face for a moment.
"Finally awake." His voice was quiet so as not to suddenly wake his two sisters.
"Where are we?" Lian turned his neck slightly and looked again at the tight space around him. At first glance, it didn’t seem to be the same place where he had passed out.
Ravian turned his head toward the outside.
"The same place we were. We only moved a few dozen meters from the battlefield." He pointed with the tip of his spear to the wall behind him.
"I found this empty crack between the roots. The entrance is narrow, and the smell of blood doesn’t reach inside much. It was safer for resting than the open space."
Lian nodded, then placed his palm on the ground and carefully checked his body.
There was no sharp pain in his ribcage. The ribs that had been broken in the battle were healed again.
He opened and closed the fingers of his right hand. The bones that had been crushed during the final strike moved without any restriction.
He flexed his shin. The torn muscles and cracked bone were completely repaired.
Even the scars from where the Parasite Threads had entered his blood had disappeared.
The flow of mana in his body was also calm, complete, and dense. Full, normal, and exactly as expected.
He had Leveled Up.
Every Level increase completely restored his body; wounds, fractures, poisons, and physical exhaustion could not withstand the wave of recovery from Leveling Up.
This was not the first time he had experienced such a thing.
But the difference between his body’s condition before losing consciousness and now was still strange.
A few hours ago, he was one step away from death. Now, not even a scratch remained on his skin.
Lian opened a brief panel.
[Level: 18]
[Physical Condition: Healthy]
"Are you all okay? How long did I sleep?" He closed the panel and looked at Ravian.
The sound of movement came from beside the wall. Sera opened her eyes and raised her head slightly.
"A few hours. Probably four or five hours." Ravian answered and then looked at his sisters.
"We’re fine too. We redressed Sera’s wound. The spores’ effect on Nemi is almost gone too."
"But you were more like a dead person than someone sleeping." Sera said with a tired but calm tone.
Lian looked at her and scratched his head. He himself remembered his condition. After that battle, such a thing was normal.
A quiet sound came from the corner of the crack. Nemi had woken up. She raised her head and looked at Lian with still sleepy eyes.
"Let’s just run away next time, okay?" Sera sighed and added.
"Let’s just hope there is no next time." Lian smiled.
For a few moments, a heavy silence formed. The memory of the battle was still too fresh.
The black threads, the dark eyes of the ants, the Queen’s massive body, and the last moment when the Parasite Thread almost reached Lian’s heart.
He also knew that the distance between victory and becoming the parasite’s new host was no more than a few seconds.
The silence was broken by a completely different sound.
Lian’s stomach growled loudly. He looked down for a moment, then turned his gaze among the three Lacerians.
"Aren’t you hungry?"
Before anyone could answer, a similar sound came from Nemi’s direction.
Her stomach also made a clear sound.
Nemi immediately lowered her head and wrapped her tail tighter around her legs.
Sera gave a very faint smile.
"What does your species eat?"
"Almost everything." Ravian said without hesitation and listed a few items with his hand.
"Meat, fruit, edible roots, some mushrooms, insect eggs. Only poisonous foods might be heavy for our bodies."
Lian thought for a moment, then reached into his storage space. Four metal cans appeared one after another in the tight space.
Then a few rectangular packages of dry bread, two packages of biscuits, and several bottles of water.
Upon seeing the cans, Nemi moved forward a little. She picked one up and examined it curiously from different angles, touching the metal surface with her fingertip.
"There’s food inside this?"
Lian picked up another can.
"Yeah."
"How do you open it?" Ravian asked hesitantly.
Lian placed his finger under the metal ring on top of the can and pulled it. The short sound of the can’s lid opening echoed in the crack’s space.
The smell of cooked meat and spices immediately filled the air.
Nemi’s eyes widened slightly. Her stomach made another sound.
"Try it." Lian handed the can to her.
Nemi first took a small piece cautiously. She smelled it. Then put it in her mouth.
For a few seconds, she chewed quietly, then without saying anything, she took a larger piece.
Sera smiled upon seeing her reaction.
But Ravian was still cautious. He opened a can of beans, tasted a little, and waited a few moments; as if he wanted to make sure his body would not react strangely.
Then his eating speed noticeably increased.
Lian opened a can of fish for himself and placed some dry bread next to it.
In that dark crack, without fire, proper dishes, or even enough space to sit, the food was simpler than it would normally be worth paying attention to.
But after days of running, wounds, poisonous spores, and a battle that could have killed them all, that cold, canned food tasted different.
Nemi ate almost the entire can of meat and then looked at the empty can with a bit of embarrassment.
"Eat this too." Lian handed her a package of biscuits.
"Does this have meat too?" She took the package.
"No."
"Then what is it?"
"It’s sweet."
Nemi tried one. A few seconds later, she kept the rest of the package near herself.
"How do these foods not spoil?" Sera asked while examining the can of fish.
Lian took a sip of water.
"They’re sealed inside containers, and they’re prepared in a way that keeps them fresh for a long time."
Sera looked at the can.
"How long?"
"Some for a few years."
The three Lacerians looked at him at the same time, and Ravian lifted the can slightly to get a better look.
"A few years?"
"As long as they’re sealed." Lian nodded.
Sera examined the metal surface again, clear curiosity visible in her gaze.
In a tribe where food storage probably depended on hunting, drying meat, and knowing forest plants, food that could last for years without spoiling was more than just a convenience.
It could save many people’s lives in winter, during sieges, or on long journeys.
But she didn’t ask more questions for now.
After finishing the food, Lian put the empty cans back into his storage space so their smell wouldn’t attract predators.
"Did you rest during these few hours?"
"More or less." Ravian shrugged and pointed to Sera and Nemi.
"One of us was always watching the entrance. First me, then Sera, and Nemi slept more."
Nemi wanted to object, but a sudden yawn cut her off.
"She was the most affected by the spores."
"Good. So we can slowly start heading toward your tribe." Lian nodded and looked toward the crack’s entrance.
"How much farther?"
Ravian calculated the route in his mind for a few moments.
"With our current condition and the speed we can move at, if we don’t have to go around, we should reach it within two days."
"Two days... not bad." Lian placed his hand on the ground and moved forward a little.
"I’ll check the outside. When I’m sure it’s safe, I’ll call you."
Ravian nodded, and Lian passed through the narrow entrance.
He pushed aside the moss strands and came out of the crack. The green light of the forest hit his eyes for a moment.
Then the scene of the battlefield appeared before him.

chapters.title: Chapter 213: Mother Of Colony
paragraphs: Thousands of Crimson Needle Ant corpses were piled on the ground.
Some were still frozen in the middle of running, some had fallen in broken and burnt piles.
Other bodies were crushed under the multi-ton caps of the mushrooms, with only parts of their legs or antennae sticking out from beneath them.
The giant mushrooms across the area were broken and bent.
Some were still covered with a white layer of ice. Some had cracked from the middle and fallen on the ground, and a number of their predatory roots remained like frozen snakes in the air.
The soil in areas where Thunder Calamity had passed was black and scorched.
Deep craters from the Queen’s arm strikes and Lian’s blows remained in the ground.
The moss in the range of Bloodborne Calamity had lost its natural color and turned into a rotten and dead red.
In the center of the field, the remains of the Black Brood Matriarch lay like a dry black mass.
Her massive armor had collapsed.
The Parasite Threads were scattered around her body like burnt veins, and part of her vertical slit was still open.
The poisonous mist had completely disappeared.
But the smell of metal, acid, venom, and burnt flesh still remained in the air.
Lian looked at the scene in silence for a few moments. This was the hardest battle he had experienced until that moment, not because the enemy was only higher in Level.
But because everything was against him, lack of mana, thousands of enemies, three vulnerable companions, and the colony’s ability to adapt and control.
He had not won because he was stronger from the start.
The Emergency Mana Crystal had restored his mana.
The Fragments had provided him with the skill he needed for such a battle.
Ravian had seen the weak point of the Brood Carapace.
The Level Up after the battle had saved his body from death.
And in the last moment, only a few centimeters remained between the Parasite Thread and his heart.
A mistake smaller than a second was enough to completely change the outcome of the battle.
Lian took his gaze off the Queen’s remains. His power had increased, but the Forest of Giants was still not a place where he could be arrogant.
At that same moment, his storage space trembled.
"Hmm?" Lian raised an eyebrow. A muffled impact was heard from inside the space.
Then a second impact.
Something inside the storage space was hitting its invisible wall.
The system panel appeared before him.
[The Devourer Egg is hungry.]
[The Devourer Egg has detected a large amount of residual biological essence.]
"Oh, I had completely forgotten about this." Lian looked at the message for a moment, then turned his gaze to the thousands of corpses around him.
"You chose a good time."
He moved his hand forward, and the Devourer Egg came out of the storage space and settled gently on the soil.
Its overall appearance had not changed much.
It had a dark and heavy shell with black and golden veins drawn on it.
But the veins were now brighter.
Every few seconds, they pulsed like living veins, and a faint light moved beneath the shell.
The egg trembled once toward Lian, then turned toward the battlefield.
"I promised you a full meal." He placed his hand on the shell’s surface.
He pointed at the corpses.
"Enjoy."
The egg trembled more intensely. Its movement was so clear that it almost looked like the excitement of a living creature.
The golden veins on the shell lit up. No crack opened on the egg, no mouth formed, but an invisible wave spread from it.
Then the nearby corpses began to change. The first Crimson Needle Ant slowly dried up.

Its red and black shell lost its color and turned into dead gray. The blood, mana, and remaining Essence inside its body separated from the carcass in the form of thin threads of red, green, and white colors.
All the threads moved toward the egg and disappeared into the shell’s veins.
The second corpse also dried up, then the third, and the process spread like a wave across the entire field.
Hundreds of bodies lost their color at the same time. Biological energy was pulled out through the cracks in their armor.

Dried blood turned into red particles, remaining mana separated from the corpses like colored mist, even the poison inside the stingers and the remaining cold in the frozen mushrooms did not resist the pulling force.
Dark green threads came out of the poisonous liquids, white particles separated from the ice.
Everything was pulled toward the egg.
The remains of the Black Brood Matriarch were the last part of the field to react.
The Queen’s dried body trembled. A very dense black vein came out from the center of her crushed core.
Its energy was different from the rest of the corpses, mixed with something like the existential pressure of a Calamity Seed.
The Devourer Egg trembled violently upon seeing it, clearly even more excited than before.
The golden veins on its shell shone like fire for a moment. The black energy separated from the Queen’s remains and sank into the egg.
The panels appeared one after another.
[Devourer Egg has consumed residual essence.]
[Large quantity of biological energy acquired.]
[High-grade Calamity Seed residue absorbed.]
[Completion: 1% → 3%]
The absorption continued.
The piles of corpses across the field turned into hollow shells.
A weak wind passed through them, and some collapsed into gray ash at that same moment.
[Incubation Completion: 3% → 5%]
Finally, the light of the egg’s veins faded. The battlefield that a few minutes ago was covered with thousands of corpses was almost empty.
Only piles of gray soil, pieces of energy-less shell, and traces of burns and ice remained on the ground.
The egg leaned forward once, then went back.
Lian looked at it.
"Were you satisfied?"
The egg trembled forward and back again, its movement exactly like a nod.
Lian couldn’t help but let out a short laugh.
"Then it’s time to go back and rest." He placed his hand on the shell and sent the egg back to the storage space.
He was not sure what this egg was and what it would become, but with just one look, it was clear that it was something transcendental.
He had never heard of eggs having consciousness.
So how powerful must the creature inside be to have such awareness even before birth?
After making sure there was no immediate danger around, he opened his panel.
A few unread messages and rewards were still in the corner of his vision, but his attention first fixed on the new talent.
[Talent: Mother of the Colony]
[Rank: S]
Lian looked at the name for a moment.
"Mother of the Colony?" For someone like him, it was a strange name. After all, he was a man.
But the description showed that the title had nothing to do with gender, but rather referred to the central and generative position of the network.
He opened the full description.
[Mother of the Colony — Rank S]
[The user becomes the central core of a colony and can add compatible creatures weaker than themselves to the colony through blood or spiritual bond.]
[Colony members can share part of their senses, location, and condition with the user and receive simple or tactical commands.]
[The loyalty of members fully accepted into the colony increases against external mental control.]
[Creatures with strong will, high Level, or high mental resistance may resist the bond.]
[Current Colony Capacity: 1/10]
[Current Colony Members: 1]
[Further functions will unlock as the Talent evolves.]
Lian kept his gaze on the last number.
One member.
He had not consciously added any creature to the colony yet.
The next panel opened.
[Innate Skill Acquired: Hive Link]
[A permanent mental connection is established between the user and colony members.]
[The user can sense the location, physical condition, threat level, and basic emotions of colony members within a specific range.]
[Current Range: 5 kilometers.]
[Functions Available: Location Detection, Condition Awareness, Basic Command Transmission, Danger Warning.]
His eyes sparkled. The new talent and innate skill he had obtained were extraordinary, still similar to the abilities of summoners.
In addition, he could now have subordinates from among monsters, although for now it was limited to only ten, but even this was unique.
Lian closed the panels and focused on Hive Link.
Almost immediately, he felt something. A small point lit up in the corner of his mind.
A sense of location, a living creature at a not-too-distant distance, was moving toward him.
Lian turned his head toward a root on the right side of the field. A few seconds later, the sound of heavy footsteps was heard from behind it.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
The moss parted, and a large Crimson Needle Worker came out from behind the root.
Its size was almost that of an elephant.
Its red and black shell was cracked in several places, and one of its back legs moved slightly imperfectly.
Nevertheless, its wounds were stabilized in an unnatural way, and no liquid was leaking from them.
Lian prepared his body, but the ant did not attack. It stopped in front of him, its long antennae moved in the air.
Then it lowered the front part of its body, its jaws close to the soil.
The ant bowed!
Hive Link conveyed very simple but clear emotions to Lian.
Obedience.
Waiting.
No hostility.
"This is under my control?" He looked at the creature without moving for a few moments.
Now he was basically a mother!

He had never heard of eggs having consciousness.
So how powerful must the creature inside be to have such awareness even before birth?
After making sure there was no immediate danger around, he opened his panel.
A few unread messages and rewards were still in the corner of his vision, but his attention first fixed on the new talent.
[Talent: Mother of the Colony]
[Rank: S]
Lian looked at the name for a moment.
"Mother of the Colony?" For someone like him, it was a strange name.
After all, he was a man.
But the description showed that the title had nothing to do with gender, but rather referred to the central and generative position of the network.
He opened the full description.
[Mother of the Colony — Rank S]
[The user becomes the central core of a colony and can add compatible creatures weaker than themselves to the colony through blood or spiritual bond.]
[Colony members can share part of their senses, location, and condition with the user and receive simple or tactical commands.]
[The loyalty of members fully accepted into the colony increases against external mental control.]
[Creatures with strong will, high Level, or high mental resistance may resist the bond.]
[Current Colony Capacity: 1/10]
[Current Colony Members: 1]
[Further functions will unlock as the Talent evolves.]
Lian kept his gaze on the last number.
One member.
He had not consciously added any creature to the colony yet.
The next panel opened.
[Innate Skill Acquired: Hive Link]
[A permanent mental connection is established between the user and colony members.]
[The user can sense the location, physical condition, threat level, and basic emotions of colony members within a specific range.]
[Current Range: 5 kilometers.]
[Functions Available: Location Detection, Condition Awareness, Basic Command Transmission, Danger Warning.]
His eyes sparkled.
The new talent and innate skill he had obtained were extraordinary, still similar to the abilities of summoners.
In addition, he could now have subordinates from among monsters, although for now it was limited to only ten, but even this was unique.
Lian closed the panels and focused on Hive Link.
Almost immediately, he felt something.
A small point lit up in the corner of his mind.
A sense of location, a living creature at a not-too-distant distance, was moving toward him.
Lian turned his head toward a root on the right side of the field.
A few seconds later, the sound of heavy footsteps was heard from behind it.
Tick.
Tick.
Tick.
The moss parted, and a large Crimson Needle Worker came out from behind the root.
Its size was almost that of an elephant.
Its red and black shell was cracked in several places, and one of its back legs moved slightly imperfectly.
Nevertheless, its wounds were stabilized in an unnatural way, and no liquid was leaking from them.
Lian prepared his body, but the ant did not attack.
It stopped in front of him, its long antennae moved in the air.
Then it lowered the front part of its body, its jaws close to the soil.
The ant bowed!
Hive Link conveyed very simple but clear emotions to Lian.
Obedience.
Waiting.
No hostility.
"This is under my control?" He looked at the creature without moving for a few moments.
Now he was basically a mother!

chapters.title: Chapter 214: Extra Life
paragraphs: Lian decided to test the ability to control this monster to see how far he could go and what limitations it had.
The ant lowered its body closer to the ground.
"Sit."
The creature immediately bent its leg joints and sat completely on the ground.
Lian sent a second command.
"Three steps forward."
The ant took exactly three steps.
Not two steps, not four steps, but exactly three steps! Then it stopped.
Lian commanded in his mind for it to turn around itself. The creature, with its massive size, spun a full circle and faced him again.
The commands were not like speaking to an animal, but like a direct transmission of intent.
There was no need to form a precise sentence in his mind; the concept was enough.
Lian decided to share his sense of sight with the monster.
In the first moment, the world split into two. He still felt his own body and saw the battlefield from his human perspective.
But at the same time, another image fell on his vision.
He saw himself from the front, from a lower height. His body appeared narrow and tall in the ant’s view.
The colors were also different.
The forest green was fainter, but the flows of heat, smell, and mana were much clearer.
The vibration of the ground formed like invisible waves in the ant’s perception.
Every movement around had its own trace. Lian even sensed the three Lacerians behind the root.
Not through sight, but through body odor, heat, and the very faint vibrations of their breathing.
The influx of two different perceptions made his head spin for a moment, the ground tilted briefly.
He immediately turned off the ability, and the second image disappeared.
He took a few quiet breaths.
Then he activated the skill again; this time not with all senses, only vision.
The pressure was much less. He was able to look around through the ant’s eyes without losing his balance.
Then he only borrowed the sense of vibration. This sense was even more useful.
The ant could detect the movement of large creatures from a very long distance through the ground.
Lian cut the connection. The value of the talent was now clear. With suitable members, he could identify paths without being directly present.
He could be aware of ambushes or predators before entering an area. He could monitor several points at the same time.
Colony members could be used for guarding, tracking, messaging, or finding resources.
In an unknown world, having creatures that could take risks on his behalf was a huge advantage.
If later he found members with special senses, the ability to fly, burrow, or stealth skills, Hive Link could become an information network that no ordinary group could compete with.
For now, the capacity was only ten members, but this Talent was still Rank S, and parts of it were locked.
Its true potential was far beyond one ant.
Now he felt even more that the battle had really been worth it. This was a very great talent.
A panel appeared.
[Would you like to name the colony member?]
Lian looked at the ant.
"You are the first member." He thought for a few moments and then said.
"Then your name will be One."
[Name registered: One.]
A summary panel of the creature appeared before him.
[Name: One]
[Race: Crimson Needle Ant]
[Level: 19]
[Rank: Normal]
[Colony Position: Worker]
[Special Traits: Paralytic Stinger, Heavy Carapace, Vibration Detection]
Lian closed the panel.
One moved its antennae gently, as if it understood that it had received a name and was happy.
At that same moment, another panel that he had not yet opened shone in the corner of his vision.
[Reward Acquired: Extra Life.]
Lian’s gaze remained fixed for a moment, then he opened the description panel.
[Extra Life]
[Upon the user’s definite death, his soul and body are restored to full condition once. All wounds, poisons, curses, and mental damage that directly caused death are cleansed.]
[Extra Lives Remaining: 1]
Lian remained motionless for a few seconds. This was no longer a Stats increase or a defensive skill.
Not a chance to escape death, not damage reduction, but a real extra life!
If he was killed once, he would return, his body and soul would be restored, and he would be revived in the nearest safe location.
He now effectively had two lives.
The value of such a reward was incomparable to any of his current skills.
He could have a second chance in a situation where anyone else would die forever with one mistake.
He could hold a hidden trump card against assassination, a fatal strike, or an enemy whose power he didn’t know.
He could even, in special circumstances, take a risk that was previously impossible.
But this did not mean carelessness. The extra life only worked once. If he wasted it on a foolish mistake, that would just be stupidity.
Lian closed the panel. This reward had to stay hidden. No one needed to know that even after death, he could rise again.
"It’s safe. You can come out." He turned toward the crack and called out.
A few moments later, the moss at the entrance parted. Ravian was the first to come out.
He kept his spear raised from the moment he exited and scanned the surroundings.
Sera appeared behind him, and Nemi crawled out of the crack last.
All three stopped upon seeing the field. Almost all the corpses had disappeared.
Where there should have been a mountain of carcasses a few minutes ago, only gray soil, lifeless shells, and traces of battle remained.
Nemi looked around in disbelief.
"Where did the bodies go?"
Before Lian could answer, One moved from behind the root. The sound of its heavy footsteps made all three react immediately.
Ravian threw himself in front of his sisters and aimed his spear at the ant’s head.
Sera pulled out her knife, and Nemi stepped back, the color draining from her face.
One moved its antennae but did not attack.
Lian laughed.
"Don’t worry. It’s not an enemy."
"This is one of them." Ravian said without lowering his spear.
"Was."
Sera turned her gaze between Lian and the ant, curiosity on her face more than fear.
"What do you mean, was?"
Lian commanded One to lower its body. The ant immediately sat down, closed its jaws, and folded its antennae.
"Now it listens to me."
Ravian still hadn’t lowered his spear.
"How?"
Lian just shrugged. He really didn’t know how to explain his world’s power system to these three. The best answer was that this was his ability.
Sera stepped forward, but Ravian grabbed her arm.
"Don’t get close."
She pushed her brother’s hand aside.
"If it wanted to attack, it would have done so by now."
She approached One more calmly. The ant showed no aggressive movement.
Sera stopped a few steps away and examined its red and black shell.
Its shell seemed thicker than the tribe’s shields, and the metal stinger at the end of its abdomen still held a drop of green venom.
Nemi stayed behind Ravian.
She peeked out slightly from beside her brother’s shoulder and looked at the ant from a distance.
Lian commanded One to lift one of its front legs. The creature obeyed, then lowered it again.
The hesitation on Ravian’s face lessened slightly. He lowered his spear, though he was still not completely at ease.
Lian looked at One’s broad back.
The ant’s size was almost that of a large elephant. The natural grooves on its shell provided enough space for four people to sit.
"I don’t think we need to walk through the rest of the forest on foot."
Ravian looked at One’s back.
Then at the massive roots and tall moss around. Gradually, he understood the meaning of Lian’s words.
One was not only faster than them, but could also pass through the moss that reached up to their waists without stopping.
Its six legs allowed it to climb the slope of roots and maintain balance on uneven surfaces.
Vibration Detection could also sense large dangers before they arrived.
Ravian, with an expression that showed he still couldn’t believe it, said:
"With this... maybe we’ll reach it in a day, even less."
"We’re going to ride it?" Nemi asked from behind him.
Lian pointed at One.
"Do you see any other way?"
Nemi looked at the ant’s massive stinger, then at its back.
"Walking wasn’t that bad either."
Sera gave a faint smile.
"Two days of walking or a few hours on this."
"On this."
Using the remaining ropes, they tied a few loops between the grooves of One’s shell.
Ravian sat at the front to show the way, Lian sat behind him and transmitted commands directly to One through Hive Link.
Sera and Nemi sat at the back and held the ropes tightly.
When everyone was ready, Lian gave the command to move.
One suddenly moved forward.
Its first movement was so fast that Nemi let out a short sound of surprise and clung to Sera.
The ant’s six legs landed on the ground with precise order.
Each leg found the right spot before landing and, without slowing down, carried its massive body over craters, exposed roots, and thick moss.
What would have taken the four of them hours was now being covered in minutes.
The cold forest wind hit their faces, and the moss strands parted on both sides.
They were on the move again... but this time, not on foot.
"Even better than what I thought." Lian muttered to himself.
Maybe they really could reach the tribe within a few hours!
